<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <base target="_top" />
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <meta name="color-scheme" content="light" />
    <title>LDP Monitor</title>
    <style>
      :root {
        --navy: #14345b;
        --accent: #2563eb;
        --ink: #172b46;
        --muted: #65768c;
        --border: #dfe6ee;
        --canvas: #f4f7fb;
        --green: #12775b;
        --red: #b83a42;
        --amber: #96651a;
        --radius: 16px;
        --shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(27, 50, 81, 0.05);
      }
      * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }
      body {
        margin: 0;
        font:
          14px/1.55 Inter,
          ui-sans-serif,
          system-ui,
          -apple-system,
          BlinkMacSystemFont,
          "Segoe UI",
          sans-serif;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--canvas);
      }
      button,
      input,
      select,
      textarea {
        font: inherit;
      }
      button,
      a,
      input,
      select,
      textarea {
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      }
      button {
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      button:disabled {
        cursor: wait;
        opacity: 0.55;
      }
      a {
        color: var(--accent);
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      a:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
      }
      button:focus-visible,
      a:focus-visible,
      input:focus-visible,
      select:focus-visible,
      textarea:focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid #b4ceff;
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }
      h1,
      h2,
      h3,
      p {
        margin-top: 0;
      }
      h1 {
        font-size: 28px;
        line-height: 1.25;
        letter-spacing: -0.6px;
      }
      h2 {
        font-size: 21px;
        line-height: 1.35;
        letter-spacing: -0.3px;
      }
      h3 {
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }
      small,
      .muted {
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .hidden,
      [hidden] {
        display: none !important;
      }
      .mono {
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .wrap {
        white-space: normal !important;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        min-height: 40px;
        padding: 9px 15px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--ink);
        font-weight: 600;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition:
          background 0.15s,
          border-color 0.15s;
      }
      .btn:hover {
        background: #f0f5fb;
        border-color: #b7c8df;
      }
      .btn.primary {
        background: var(--navy);
        border-color: var(--navy);
        color: #fff;
      }
      .btn.primary:hover {
        background: #204a7b;
      }
      .btn.danger {
        color: var(--red);
      }
      .btn.small {
        min-height: 33px;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .btn.icon {
        padding: 8px;
        min-width: 40px;
      }
      .btn svg,
      .icon-svg {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
        flex: none;
      }
      .actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 9px;
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .actions.end {
        justify-content: flex-end;
      }
      .field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
      }
      .field label {
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 12px;
        color: #42556f;
      }
      .field input,
      .field select,
      .field textarea,
      .filters input,
      .filters select {
        min-width: 0;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        min-height: 42px;
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--ink);
        border: 1px solid #ced8e4;
        border-radius: 9px;
      }
      .field textarea {
        min-height: 88px;
        resize: vertical;
      }
      .field input:read-only {
        background: #f2f5f9;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .field-help {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .field-check {
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        align-items: center;
        margin: 12px 0;
      }
      .field-check input {
        accent-color: var(--accent);
        width: 17px;
        height: 17px;
      }
      .form-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 0 18px;
      }
      .full {
        grid-column: 1/-1;
      }
      .login-page {
        min-height: 100dvh;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        background: #fff;
      }
      .login-brand {
        padding: clamp(32px, 7vw, 100px);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: center;
        background: #eaf1fa;
      }
      .login-brand .brand-logo {
        display: block;
        width: 460px;
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
      }
      .eyebrow {
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 1.8px;
        font-size: 11px;
        color: #4d6990;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
      }
      .login-brand h1 {
        font-size: clamp(30px, 3.1vw, 46px);
        max-width: 500px;
        letter-spacing: -1.4px;
      }
      .login-brand p {
        color: #4b6586;
        max-width: 410px;
        font-size: 16px;
      }
      .login-steps {
        display: flex;
        gap: 24px;
        margin-top: 28px;
        color: #4e6683;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .login-steps strong {
        display: block;
        font-size: 22px;
        color: var(--navy);
        margin-bottom: 4px;
      }
      .login-form-wrap {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        padding: 36px;
      }
      .login-form {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 365px;
      }
      .login-form h2 {
        font-size: 26px;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }
      .login-form .sub {
        color: var(--muted);
        margin-bottom: 28px;
      }
      .login-mobile-logo {
        display: none;
        width: 240px;
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }
      .login-form .primary {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 8px;
        min-height: 45px;
      }
      .login-footnote {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
        margin-top: 20px;
      }
      .form-error {
        padding: 12px 14px;
        background: #fff1f1;
        color: var(--red);
        border: 1px solid #f2c8cc;
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .app {
        display: flex;
        min-height: 100dvh;
      }
      .sidebar {
        width: 242px;
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0 auto 0 0;
        background: #fff;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        z-index: 30;
      }
      .sidebar-brand {
        padding: 16px 20px 12px;
      }
      .sidebar-brand img {
        width: 190px;
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
      }
      .sidebar-label {
        padding: 0 24px;
        color: #8c9aab;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 1.6px;
        margin: 14px 0 10px;
      }
      .sidebar nav {
        padding: 0 12px;
        flex: 1;
        overflow: auto;
      }
      .nav-item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        margin: 4px 0;
        color: #5f7189;
        border: 0;
        background: transparent;
        border-radius: 11px;
        text-align: left;
        font-weight: 550;
      }
      .nav-item:hover {
        background: #f6f8fb;
        color: var(--navy);
      }
      .nav-item.active {
        background: #eaf1fd;
        color: #2055a4;
      }
      .sidebar-user {
        margin: 14px;
        padding: 15px 10px 4px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .user-head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
      }
      .avatar {
        width: 35px;
        height: 35px;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border-radius: 11px;
        background: #eaf1fa;
        color: var(--navy);
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .user-name {
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 650;
        max-width: 151px;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .user-role {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .sidebar-user .actions {
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .sidebar-user .btn {
        flex: 1;
      }
      .main {
        margin-left: 242px;
        width: calc(100% - 242px);
      }
      .topbar {
        height: 78px;
        padding: 0 36px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        background: #fff;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 20;
        gap: 15px;
      }
      .breadcrumb {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .breadcrumb strong {
        color: var(--ink);
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .topbar .actions {
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
      }
      .sync-label {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .menu-toggle {
        display: none;
      }
      .content {
        padding: 32px 36px 55px;
        max-width: 1550px;
        margin: auto;
      }
      .page-head {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 26px;
      }
      .page-head h1 {
        margin-bottom: 7px;
      }
      .page-head p {
        color: var(--muted);
        margin: 0;
      }
      .card {
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        padding: 24px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }
      .card h3 {
        margin-bottom: 16px;
      }
      .grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 20px;
      }
      .grid .card {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }
      .grid.three {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
      .grid.four {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
      .section-heading {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        margin: 30px 0 16px;
      }
      .section-heading h2 {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .metric-label {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .metric {
        font-size: 32px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: -0.8px;
        margin: 12px 0 5px;
      }
      .metric-sub {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.5;
        white-space: nowrap;
        color: #526985;
        background: #edf2f8;
      }
      .badge.green {
        background: #e7f5ef;
        color: #126d51;
      }
      .badge.amber {
        background: #fff3da;
        color: #966415;
      }
      .badge.red {
        background: #fceced;
        color: #ad3c45;
      }
      .badge.blue {
        background: #eaf1ff;
        color: #285bb0;
      }
      .program-tag {
        display: inline-block;
        letter-spacing: 0.6px;
        color: #335b92;
        background: #edf3fc;
        border: 1px solid #dce7f7;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .program-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 15px;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
      }
      .program-header h2 {
        margin: 13px 0 4px;
      }
      .program-meta {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .program-summary {
        display: flex;
        gap: 30px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin-top: 22px;
        padding-top: 18px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .program-summary label {
        display: block;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 11px;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
      }
      .program-summary strong {
        font-size: 19px;
        font-weight: 650;
      }
      .progress-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .phase {
        display: block;
        min-width: 0;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: #fff;
        padding: 16px;
        text-align: left;
        color: var(--ink);
      }
      button.phase:hover {
        border-color: #92b4e3;
        box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #dae5f666;
      }
      .phase.current {
        border-color: #92b4e3;
        background: #f4f8ff;
      }
      .phase.done {
        background: #fafdfb;
        border-color: #d7e8de;
      }
      .phase-name {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 650;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
      }
      .phase-score {
        font-size: 25px;
        font-weight: 650;
        margin: 10px 0 3px;
      }
      .phase .muted {
        display: block;
        font-size: 10px;
        margin-top: 9px;
      }
      .participant-scores .phase {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }
      .participant-scores .phase > .muted:last-child {
        margin-top: auto;
        padding-top: 9px;
      }
      .participant-scores .phase > .badge { align-self: flex-start; }
      .participant-scores .score-secondary {
        grid-column: span 2;
      }
      .participant-scores button.phase:focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid var(--accent);
        outline-offset: 3px;
      }
      .program-certificate {
        margin-top: 22px;
        padding: 20px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 12px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .program-certificate h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; }
      .program-certificate p { margin: 0; }
      @media (max-width: 820px) {
        .participant-scores .score-secondary { grid-column: auto; }
      }
      @media (max-width: 480px) {
        .progress-grid.participant-scores { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        .program-certificate { align-items: flex-start; }
        .program-certificate .btn { width: 100%; }
      }
      .summary-line {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--muted);
        display: flex;
        gap: 15px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin: 12px 0;
      }
      .notice {
        padding: 14px 16px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #edf4fd;
        color: #365a88;
        font-size: 13px;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
      }
      .notice.amber {
        background: #fff5e2;
        color: #8a641e;
      }
      .notice.green {
        background: #eaf6f0;
        color: #226e56;
      }
      .notice p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }
      .remedial-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 12px 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
      .remedial-row:first-child {
        border-top: 0;
      }
      .remedial-row strong {
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .remedial-row small {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 3px;
      }
      .progress-track {
        height: 6px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #eaf0f7;
        overflow: hidden;
        margin-top: 19px;
      }
      .progress-track span {
        display: block;
        height: 100%;
        background: #608fc8;
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .filters {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
      }
      .filters input {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 180px;
      }
      .filters select {
        width: auto;
        min-width: 145px;
      }
      .table-card {
        padding: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .table-scroll {
        overflow-x: auto;
      }
      table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      th {
        text-align: left;
        padding: 13px 18px;
        background: #f8fafd;
        color: #6d7e94;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 650;
        letter-spacing: 0.35px;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      td {
        padding: 15px 18px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f6;
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      tbody tr:last-child td {
        border-bottom: 0;
      }
      tbody tr:hover {
        background: #fbfcff;
      }
      td .muted {
        font-size: 11px;
        display: block;
        margin-top: 3px;
      }
      .table-name {
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #2b425f;
      }
      .table-actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .pagination {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 14px 18px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .pagination .actions {
        gap: 6px;
      }
      .bulk-bar {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 15px;
        padding: 13px 16px;
        border: 1px solid #d7e4f6;
        border-radius: 11px;
        background: #edf4ff;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
      }
      .bulk-bar select {
        border: 1px solid #c8d7eb;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 7px;
      }
      .empty {
        text-align: center;
        padding: 45px 25px;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .empty .icon-svg {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        color: #8ba3bf;
        margin: 0 auto 12px;
        display: block;
      }
      .empty h3 {
        color: #415873;
        margin-bottom: 7px;
      }
      .empty p {
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .details-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 20px;
      }
      .details-grid label {
        display: block;
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--muted);
        margin-bottom: 5px;
      }
      .details-grid strong {
        font-size: 13px;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .file-input {
        display: block;
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 14px;
        border: 1px dashed #becde0;
        background: #f7faff;
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .certificate-ready {
        border-left: 3px solid var(--green);
      }
      dialog {
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 18px;
        width: min(850px, calc(100vw - 32px));
        max-height: 88dvh;
        color: var(--ink);
        box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(10, 32, 64, 0.2);
      }
      dialog::backdrop {
        background: rgba(19, 38, 64, 0.36);
      }
      .modal-content {
        padding: 28px;
      }
      .modal-header {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 22px;
      }
      .modal-header h2 {
        margin-bottom: 5px;
      }
      .modal-header p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .modal-content .form-grid {
        margin-top: 18px;
      }
      .modal-content .table-scroll {
        margin: 0 -5px;
      }
      .modal-content table td {
        white-space: normal;
      }
      .modal-content td input {
        width: 95px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding: 9px;
        border-radius: 8px;
      }
      .modal-content td input[type="url"] {
        width: 190px;
      }
      .modal-actions {
        margin-top: 25px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .modal-close {
        border: 0;
        background: #f0f4f8;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-size: 22px;
        color: #5d718b;
        width: 32px;
        height: 32px;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .checkbox-grid {
        display: flex;
        gap: 20px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .toast-stack {
        position: fixed;
        right: 24px;
        bottom: 24px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
        z-index: 100;
      }
      .toast {
        border: 1px solid #c5dfd3;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: #fff;
        padding: 13px 18px;
        max-width: 420px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #243b5922;
        color: var(--green);
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .toast.error {
        border-color: #ebc4c9;
        color: var(--red);
      }
      #networkBanner {
        padding: 9px 20px;
        text-align: center;
        background: #fff1dd;
        color: #8b6421;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .global-progress {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 3px;
        z-index: 100;
        pointer-events: none;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .global-progress.active::after {
        content: "";
        display: block;
        width: 35%;
        height: 100%;
        background: var(--accent);
        animation: progress 1.1s infinite linear;
      }
      .skeleton {
        height: 17px;
        background: #e6edf6;
        border-radius: 5px;
        margin: 13px 0;
        animation: pulse 1.3s infinite alternate;
      }
      .skeleton.card-placeholder {
        height: 170px;
        border-radius: 15px;
      }
      .loading-state {
        padding: 20px 0;
      }
      .spinner {
        display: inline-block;
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
        border: 2px solid #c6d4e7;
        border-top-color: var(--accent);
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: spin 0.7s linear infinite;
        vertical-align: middle;
        margin-right: 8px;
      }
      .sidebar-backdrop {
        display: none;
      }
      @keyframes spin {
        to {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }
      @keyframes progress {
        from {
          transform: translateX(-110%);
        }
        to {
          transform: translateX(400%);
        }
      }
      @keyframes pulse {
        to {
          opacity: 0.45;
        }
      }
      @media (min-width: 1600px) {
        .content {
          padding-top: 42px;
        }
        .card {
          padding: 28px;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 1120px) {
        .grid.four {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }
        .details-grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }
        .sidebar {
          width: 220px;
        }
        .main {
          margin-left: 220px;
          width: calc(100% - 220px);
        }
        .content {
          padding: 27px 25px;
        }
        .topbar {
          padding: 0 25px;
        }
        .grid.three {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .progress-grid {
          gap: 9px;
        }
        .phase {
          padding: 12px;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 820px) {
        .login-page {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .login-brand {
          display: none;
        }
        .login-mobile-logo {
          display: block;
        }
        .login-form-wrap {
          min-height: 100dvh;
          padding: 25px;
        }
        .sidebar {
          transform: translateX(-100%);
          transition: transform 0.18s;
        }
        .sidebar.open {
          transform: translateX(0);
        }
        .sidebar-backdrop.open {
          display: block;
          position: fixed;
          inset: 0;
          background: #17314a55;
          z-index: 25;
        }
        .main {
          margin-left: 0;
          width: 100%;
        }
        .menu-toggle {
          display: inline-flex;
        }
        .topbar {
          height: 66px;
          padding: 0 20px;
        }
        .content {
          padding: 25px 20px;
        }
        .grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .page-head {
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 14px;
        }
        .page-head h1 {
          font-size: 24px;
        }
        .program-header h2 {
          font-size: 19px;
        }
        .sync-label {
          display: none;
        }
        .progress-grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }
        .filters input {
          flex-basis: 100%;
        }
        .filters select {
          flex: 1;
        }
        .modal-content {
          padding: 22px;
        }
        .bulk-bar {
          align-items: flex-start;
          flex-direction: column;
        }
        .bulk-bar .actions {
          width: 100%;
        }
        .toast-stack {
          left: 16px;
          right: 16px;
          bottom: 16px;
        }
        .toast {
          max-width: none;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 480px) {
        .form-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          gap: 0;
        }
        .details-grid {
          gap: 18px 12px;
        }
        .grid.four {
          gap: 12px;
        }
        .grid.four .card {
          padding: 17px;
        }
        .metric {
          font-size: 27px;
        }
        .card {
          padding: 20px;
        }
        .table-card {
          padding: 0;
        }
        .progress-grid {
          gap: 9px;
        }
        .program-summary {
          gap: 22px;
        }
        .remedial-row {
          align-items: flex-start;
          flex-direction: column;
        }
        .filters select {
          min-width: 125px;
        }
        td,
        th {
          padding-left: 13px;
          padding-right: 13px;
        }
        .modal-actions .btn {
          flex: 1;
        }
        .pagination {
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .login-form h2 {
          font-size: 24px;
        }
        .btn {
          white-space: normal;
        }
        .topbar .btn {
          white-space: nowrap;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
          animation: none !important;
          transition: none !important;
        }
      }
      .raw-mappings {
        margin: 18px 0;
      }
      .raw-map-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 22px;
        padding: 14px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        align-items: center;
      }
      .raw-map-row .field {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }
      .raw-issues {
        margin: 18px 0;
      }
      .raw-progress {
        width: 100%;
        height: 12px;
        accent-color: var(--accent);
      }
      .behavior-entry {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding: 20px 0;
      }
      .panelist-feedback {
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #f7f9fc;
        padding: 16px;
        margin: 14px 0;
      }
      .panelist-feedback h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; }
      .panelist-feedback p {
        margin: 0;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }
      .behavior-link {
        border: 0;
        padding: 0;
        background: none;
        color: var(--accent);
        text-align: left;
      }
      @media (max-width: 700px) {
        .raw-map-row {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          gap: 8px;
        }
      }

      .raw-program-panels {
        margin-bottom: 22px;
      }
      .raw-program-panel.selected {
        border: 2px solid var(--accent);
        background: #f7faff;
      }

      .program-summary small {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 3px;
      }
/* ---------- Dashboard: Ringkasan Program (screenshot layout) ---------- */
  .talent-program-stack { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:28px; }
  .talent-program-card {
    background:#fff; border:1px solid #e6ebf2; border-top:6px solid #111827;
    border-radius:28px; padding:32px; box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(15,31,61,.08);
  }
  .talent-program-card.tshdp { border-top-color:#09a8d2; }
  .talent-program-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:18px; margin-bottom:28px; }
  .talent-program-name { font-size:26px; line-height:1.1; font-weight:800; color:#07152e; }
  .talent-program-meta { margin-top:6px; color:#98a4b8; font-size:16px; }
  .talent-program-open {
    appearance:none; border:1px solid #dfe5ee; background:#fff; color:#07152e; border-radius:14px;
    padding:12px 20px; font-size:15px; font-weight:750; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .talent-program-open:hover { background:#f7f9fd; border-color:#c6d1e0; }
  .talent-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:14px; }
  .talent-metric { border:1px solid #dfe5ee; border-radius:17px; padding:18px 18px 16px; min-height:128px; background:#fff; }
  .talent-metric-link { appearance:none; text-align:left; font:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
  .talent-metric-link:hover { border-color:#a8bfdc; background:#f7faff; }
  .talent-metric-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2563eb; outline-offset:3px; }
  .talent-track-note { margin:12px 0 0; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; }
  @media (min-width:1101px) and (max-width:1350px) { .talent-metrics { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px; } .talent-metric { padding:16px 12px; } }
  .talent-metric-label { color:#9aa6ba; font-size:13px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.015em; text-transform:uppercase; }
  .talent-metric-value { margin-top:8px; color:#07152e; font-size:38px; line-height:1; font-weight:850; }
  .talent-metric-value.green { color:#08a64c; }
  .talent-metric-value.red { color:#e32424; }
  .talent-metric-value.blue { color:#2859ef; }
  .talent-metric-sub { margin-top:8px; color:#98a4b8; font-size:14px; line-height:1.35; }
  .talent-progress { display:flex; height:14px; margin-top:26px; border-radius:999px; overflow:hidden; background:#eef2f7; }
  .talent-progress > span { display:block; height:100%; }
  .talent-progress-passed { background:#16a34a; }
  .talent-progress-ongoing { background:#2f63eb; }
  .talent-progress-failed { background:#e52626; }
  .talent-legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:20px; align-items:center; margin-top:12px; color:#42516a; font-size:14px; }
  .talent-legend-item { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .talent-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; flex:none; }
  .talent-dot.green { background:#16a34a; }
  .talent-dot.blue { background:#2f63eb; }
  .talent-dot.red { background:#e52626; }
  .talent-dot.navy { background:#111827; }
  .talent-region-wrap { margin-top:26px; }
  .talent-region-title { color:#9aa6ba; font-size:13px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.02em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .talent-region-list { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; }
  .talent-region-chip {
    appearance:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; border:1px solid #dfe5ee; background:#f8fafd;
    color:#07152e; border-radius:999px; padding:8px 12px 8px 16px; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .talent-region-chip:hover { background:#eef4ff; border-color:#bfcce0; transform:translateY(-1px); }
  .talent-region-count {
    min-width:34px; height:28px; padding:0 9px; border:1px solid #e1e6ee; border-radius:999px; background:#fff;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:800; color:#07152e;
  }
  @media (max-width:900px) {
    .talent-program-card { padding:24px; border-radius:22px; }
    .talent-metrics { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  }
  @media (max-width:560px) {
    .talent-program-head { flex-direction:column; }
    .talent-program-open { width:100%; }
    .talent-metrics { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .talent-program-name { font-size:23px; }
    .talent-program-meta { font-size:14px; }
  }


      .raw-program-tabs { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0 0 18px; }
      #moduleLinksRows input { min-width:240px; width:100%; }
      @media(max-width:560px) { #moduleLinksRows input { min-width:180px; } }

      /* Three-column score table; all remedial actions live in the section below. */
      dialog { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: calc(100vw - 24px); overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto; }
      .modal-content { min-width: 0; }
      .modal-header > div { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
      .modal-close { flex-shrink: 0; }
      .assessment-view { min-width: 0; }
      .assessment-table { width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; }
      .assessment-table .competency-col { width: 43%; }
      .assessment-table .score-col { width: 23%; }
      .assessment-table .status-col { width: 34%; }
      .assessment-table th { background: transparent; white-space: normal; font-size: 10px; padding: 12px 10px; }
      .modal-content .assessment-table td { padding: 12px 10px; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
      .assessment-table .badge { max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.35; }
      .modal-content .assessment-table .assessment-score-input { width: 100%; max-width: 90px; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 9px; }
      .assessment-static-score { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 90px; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; }
      .assessment-average { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 18px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: #eaf2ff; font-size: 13px; }
      .assessment-average strong { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.2; }
      .assessment-remedial-block { margin-top: 16px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #f1d18d; border-radius: 12px; background: #fffaf0; }
      .assessment-remedial-block h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1dcae; color: #8a641e; font-size: 15px; }
      .assessment-remedial-block .remedial-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr); gap: 16px; border-top-color: #f1dcae; }
      .assessment-remedial-block .remedial-row > div { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
      .assessment-remedial-block .remedial-row strong { font-size: 13px; }
      .assessment-remedial-block .remedial-row small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
      .assessment-remedial-block .btn { background: #102142; border-color: #102142; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; white-space: normal; text-align: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; }
      .assessment-save { margin-top: 16px; }
      .assessment-save .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; background: #102142; border-color: #102142; }
      @media (max-width: 480px) {
        .assessment-table th, .modal-content .assessment-table td { padding-left: 6px; padding-right: 6px; }
        .assessment-table .badge { font-size: 9px; }
        .assessment-average { padding: 14px; gap: 8px 10px; }
        .assessment-remedial-block { padding: 14px; }
        .assessment-remedial-block .remedial-row { gap: 10px; }
      }

      .program-progress-stack { display:grid; gap:24px; }
      .program-progress-panel { border-top:4px solid #14345b; min-width:0; }
      .program-progress-panel.tshdp { border-top-color:#14a3b8; }
      .program-progress-heading { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom:22px; }
      .program-progress-heading h2 { margin:10px 0 0; font-size:22px; }
      .program-progress-filters { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; margin-bottom:18px; }
      .program-progress-filters label { display:grid; gap:7px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }
      .program-progress-filters input,.program-progress-filters select { width:100%; min-width:0; }
      .program-progress-metrics { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:10px; }
      .program-progress-metric { text-align:left; background:#f7f9fc; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; color:#14345b; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; }
      .program-progress-metric.selected { background:#ecf3ff; border-color:#14345b; }
      .program-progress-metric:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #14a3b8; outline-offset:3px; }
      .program-progress-metric span { display:block; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:8px; }
      .program-progress-metric strong { font-size:26px; }
      .program-progress-completion { display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center; margin:18px 0; color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; }
      .program-progress-track { flex:1; height:7px; border-radius:8px; background:#e8edf4; overflow:hidden; }
      .program-progress-track span { display:block; height:100%; background:#14a3b8; }
      .program-progress-panel .table-card { border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:none; }
      @media(max-width:700px) {
        .program-progress-heading { align-items:flex-start; flex-direction:column; }
        .program-progress-filters,.program-progress-metrics { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      }
      @media(max-width:420px) { .program-progress-filters { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
      .segment-picker{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;max-width:880px}.segment-card{padding:28px}.segment-card h2{font-size:30px;margin:16px 0 8px}.segment-card p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}@media(max-width:640px){.segment-picker{grid-template-columns:1fr}.segment-card{padding:22px}}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="globalProgress" class="global-progress" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div id="networkBanner" hidden role="status">
      Koneksi internet terputus. Perubahan belum dapat dikirim.
    </div>
    <section id="loginPage" class="login-page">
      <div class="login-brand">
        <img
          class="brand-logo"
          data-logo width="1678" height="937"
          alt="Leadership Development Program"
        />
        <h1>Leadership Development Program</h1>
      </div>
      <div class="login-form-wrap">
        <form id="loginForm" class="login-form" data-testid="login-form">
          <img
            class="login-mobile-logo"
            data-logo width="1678" height="937"
            alt="Leadership Development Program"
          />
          <div class="eyebrow">LDP Monitor</div>
          <h2>Selamat datang kembali</h2>
          <p class="sub">Masuk untuk melanjutkan program Anda.</p>
          <div id="loginError" class="form-error" hidden role="alert"></div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="loginRole">Masuk sebagai</label
            ><select id="loginRole" name="role">
              <option value="PARTICIPANT">Peserta</option>
              <option value="ADMIN">Admin</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label for="nik">NIK</label
            ><input
              id="nik"
              name="nik"
              autocomplete="username"
              inputmode="numeric"
              placeholder="Masukkan NIK Anda"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div id="passwordField" class="field" hidden>
            <label for="password">Password Admin</label
            ><input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autocomplete="current-password"
              aria-describedby="adminPasswordHelp"
            />
            <small id="adminPasswordHelp" class="muted">Gunakan password dari User Import. Jika belum diatur, buat password minimal 8 karakter saat login pertama.</small>
          </div>
          <button id="loginSubmit" type="submit" class="btn primary" disabled>
            Masuk
          </button>
          <p id="loginState" class="login-footnote">Menyiapkan aplikasi…</p>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>
    <div id="sidebarBackdrop" class="sidebar-backdrop"></div>
    <div id="app" class="app" hidden>
      <aside id="sidebar" class="sidebar" aria-label="Navigasi utama">
        <div class="sidebar-brand">
          <img data-logo width="1678" height="937" alt="Leadership Development Program" />
        </div>
        <div class="sidebar-label">WORKSPACE</div>
        <nav id="sidebarNav"></nav>
        <div class="sidebar-user">
          <div class="user-head">
            <div id="avatar" class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">U</div>
            <div>
              <div id="userName" class="user-name"></div>
              <div id="userRole" class="user-role"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="actions">
            <button
              id="switchRole"
              type="button"
              class="btn small"
              data-action="switch-role"
              hidden
            >
              Ganti peran</button
            ><button type="button" class="btn small" data-action="logout">
              Keluar
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <main class="main">
        <header class="topbar">
          <div class="actions">
            <button
              id="menuButton"
              type="button"
              class="btn icon menu-toggle"
              data-action="menu"
              aria-label="Buka navigasi"
            ></button>
            <div class="breadcrumb">
              LDP Monitor <span aria-hidden="true"> / </span>
              <strong id="pageLabel">Overview</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="actions">
            <span id="syncLabel" class="sync-label"></span
            ><button
              id="refreshButton"
              type="button"
              class="btn small"
              data-action="refresh"
            >
              Muat ulang
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>
        <div id="content" class="content" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </main>
    </div>
    <dialog id="dialog" aria-label="Detail dan formulir">
      <div id="modalContent" class="modal-content"></div>
    </dialog>
    <div id="toasts" class="toast-stack" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <script>
      const EMBEDDED_LOGO =
        "data:image/webp;base64,";
      /* LDP Monitor UI. One router, one RPC queue, and one owner for every screen. */
      ("use strict");
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
      const S = {
        token: null,
        segment: "B2B",
        session: null,
        dashboard: null,
        view: "overview",
        params: {},
        epoch: 0,
        nav: 0,
        modal: 0,
        active: 0,
        queue: [],
        inflight: new Map(),
        cache: new Map(),
        viewRefreshes: new Map(),
        backgroundReadKeys: new Set(),
        rows: [],
        selected: new Set(),
        enrollmentId: "",
        auditStack: [],
        auditBefore: null,
        readGeneration: 0,
      };
      const PHASES = [
        "PHASE 1",
        "PHASE 2",
        "PHASE 3",
        "PANELISASI",
        "COMPLETED",
      ];
      const STATUSES = ["ELIGIBLE", "NOT ELIGIBLE", "PROMOSI", "RESIGN", "BYPASS"];
      const RESULTS = ["ON GOING", "PASSED", "REMEDIAL", "NOT PASSED"];
      const LABELS = {
        segments: "Pilih Segmen",
        overview: "Overview",
        programprogress: "Progress Program",
        progress: "Progres Belajar",
        project: "Project",
        evidence: "Mentoring",
        mycertificate: "Sertifikat",
        database: "Database Peserta",
        users: "User dan Akses",
        certificates: "Sertifikat",
        qleap: "Hasil QLEAP",
        settings: "Pengaturan",
        audit: "Riwayat Aktivitas",
        detail: "Detail Peserta",
        legacy: "Pemetaan Data Lama",

      function icon(name) {

          (PATHS[name] || PATHS.list) +
          '"/></svg>'
        );
      }
      function esc(v) {
        return String(v === null || v === undefined ? "" : v).replace(
          /[&<>"']/g,
          (c) =>
            ({
              "&": "&amp;",
              "<": "&lt;",
              ">": "&gt;",
              '"': "&quot;",
              "'": "&#39;",
            })[c],
        );
      }
      function fmt(v) {
        return v === "" || v === null || v === undefined ? "—" : esc(v);

      function safeUrl(v) {

      }
      function link(url, label) {

              "</a>"

      function badge(value) {

            "PASS",
            "COMPLETED",
            "COMPLETE",
            "DONE",
            "ELIGIBLE",
            "AKTIF",
            "GENERATED",
          ].includes(k)
            ? "green"
            : ["FAILED", "RESIGN", "BERHENTI", "TIDAK LULUS", "NOT PASSED"].includes(k)
              ? "red"
              : [
                    "REMEDIAL",
                    "REMEDIAL REQUIRED",
                    "QUEUED",
                    "PROCESSING",
                    "NOT ELIGIBLE",
                    "PARTIAL",
                  ].includes(k)

                : "blue";
        return '<span class="badge ' + tone + '">' + esc(v) + "</span>";

      function message(e) {

      function toast(text, error = false) {
        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "toast" + (error ? " error" : "");

      function handleError(e) {

          $("loginError").textContent = message(e);

      function segmentPrograms_(segment=S.segment) {

          }).join('')+'</div>');

      async function switchSegment_(segment,view="overview") {
        if(!["B2B","B2C"].includes(segment)) throw Error("Segmen tidak valid.");
        if(!(S.dashboard?.availableSegments || ["B2B","B2C"]).includes(segment)) throw Error("Anda belum terdaftar pada segmen ini.");
        if(rawImportState.running || oneClickSync_.running || dashboardSheetSync_.running || legacyMigrationState.running)
          return toast("Tunggu proses penyimpanan selesai sebelum mengganti segmen.",true);
        S.epoch++;S.readGeneration++;S.nav++;S.segment=segment;
        S.cache.clear();clearRetainedViews_();S.inflight.clear();S.viewRefreshes.clear();S.backgroundReadKeys.clear();
        S.queue.splice(0).forEach(job=>job.reject(staleError()));S.selected.clear();S.enrollmentId="";S.rows=[];S.pageData=null;S.workspace=null;
        S.auditBefore=null;S.auditStack=[];S.certImportBatch="";closeModal();
        Object.assign(listState,{page:1,search:"",program:"",region:"",batch:"",status:"",phase:"",track:""});
        Object.assign(certPage,{page:1,search:""});Object.assign(qleapPage,{page:1,search:"",onlyRemedial:false});
        Object.assign(rawImportState,{epoch:-1,options:null,preview:null,job:null,running:false,selected:null});
        Object.assign(moduleLinkState,{epoch:-1,options:null,program:"TSHDP",phase:"PHASE 1",drafts:{}});
        Object.assign(rawBundle_,{epoch:-1,files:[],running:false});Object.assign(oneClickSync_,{epoch:-1,run:null,running:false});
        Object.assign(dashboardSheetSync_,{epoch:-1,progress:null,running:false});Object.assign(legacyMigrationState,{epoch:-1,preview:null,job:null,running:false});
        S.view="segments";content(pageHead("Dashboard "+segment,"")+loading());
        const epoch=S.epoch,d=await resource("getDashboardBootstrap",[],30000,true);
        if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;
        if(d.segment!==segment)throw Error("Backend belum mendukung segmen. Ganti Code.gs dan deploy versi terbaru sebelum melanjutkan.");
        applyDashboard_(d);await navigate(view,{},false);

      function resetSession() {
        S.epoch++;
        S.readGeneration++;
        S.nav++;
        S.token = null;
        S.segment = "B2B";
        S.session = null;
        S.dashboard = null;
        S.cache.clear();
        clearRetainedViews_();
        S.viewRefreshes.clear();
        S.backgroundReadKeys.clear();
        S.inflight.clear();
        S.selected.clear();
        S.enrollmentId = "";
        S.queue.splice(0).forEach((job) => job.reject(staleError()));
        closeModal();
        $("app").hidden = true;
        $("loginPage").hidden = false;
        $("password").value = "";
      }
      function pump() {
        while (S.active < 2 && S.queue.length) {
          // A popup/menu read goes ahead of a queued background summary.
          const index=S.queue.findIndex(j=>!j.background),
            job=S.queue.splice(index<0?0:index,1)[0];
          if(job.epoch!==S.epoch) {job.reject(staleError());continue;}
          S.active++;$("globalProgress").classList.add("active");
          let completed=false;
          const started=Date.now();
          const finish=(ok,value,timedOut=false)=>{
            if(completed) return;
            completed=true;clearTimeout(timer);
            S.active=Math.max(0,S.active-1);
            if(job.epoch!==S.epoch) job.reject(staleError());
            else if(ok) job.resolve(value);
            else job.reject(value instanceof Error ? value : new Error((value && value.message)||String(value)));
            if(!S.active) $("globalProgress").classList.remove("active");
            console.log(JSON.stringify({event:"LDP_REQUEST",endpoint:job.name,ok:!!ok,
              queueMs:started-job.queuedAt,ms:Date.now()-started,timedOut:!!timedOut}));
            // Timeout cannot cancel a server execution. Never replay it.
            pump();
          };
          const timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(false,new Error(job.read ?
            "Permintaan membutuhkan waktu lebih lama. Silakan coba lagi setelah proses selesai." :
            "Status penyimpanan belum dapat dipastikan. Periksa data sebelum mengulangi tindakan."),true),job.read?35000:180000);
          try {
            if(typeof google==="undefined" || !google.script || !google.script.run)
              throw new Error("Buka aplikasi melalui URL deployment Google Apps Script.");
            google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(r=>finish(true,r)).withFailureHandler(e=>finish(false,e))[job.name](...job.args);
          } catch(e) {finish(false,e);}
        }
      }
      function rpc(name,...args) {
        if(navigator.onLine===false) return Promise.reject(new Error("Koneksi terputus. Sambungkan internet lalu coba kembali."));
        const read=name.startsWith("get") || name.startsWith("export"),
          key=S.epoch+"|"+S.readGeneration+"|"+name+"|"+JSON.stringify(args);
        if(read && S.inflight.has(key)) return S.inflight.get(key);
        const promise=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
          const explicit=args.find(arg=>arg && typeof arg==="object" && !Array.isArray(arg) && arg.segment),
            segment=["login","getLoginConfig","switchRole"].includes(name) ? "ALL" : explicit?.segment || S.segment;
          S.queue.push({name,args:[...args,{__ldpContext:1,segment}],read,resolve,reject,epoch:S.epoch,queuedAt:Date.now(),
            background:S.backgroundReadKeys.has(key) || ["getParticipantDashboardData","getOverviewStats"].includes(name)});
          pump();
        });
        if(read) {
          S.inflight.set(key,promise);
          promise.then(()=>S.inflight.delete(key),()=>S.inflight.delete(key));
        }
        return promise;
      }
      async function resource(name,args=[],ttl=45000,force=false,options={}) {
        args=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(args));
        const retained=rememberRetainedRead_(name,args,ttl,options);
        const epoch=S.epoch,generation=S.readGeneration,
          key=epoch+"|"+name+"|"+JSON.stringify(args),cached=S.cache.get(key);
        if(!force && cached && Date.now()-cached.ts<ttl) {
          rememberRetainedResult_(retained,cached.data);return cached.data;
        }
        const freshEndpoints=['getParticipantPage','getParticipantWorkspace','getCertificatesOverview',
          'getQleapPostTestRecap','getMyQleapPostTest','getProgramProgress','getOverviewStats','getParticipantDashboardData'];
        const requestArgs=force && options.freshSource!==false && freshEndpoints.includes(name)
          ? [{...args[0],fresh:true},...args.slice(1)] : args;
        const data=await rpc(name,S.token,...requestArgs);
        if(epoch!==S.epoch || generation!==S.readGeneration) throw staleError();
        S.cache.set(key,{ts:Date.now(),data});
        while(S.cache.size>80) S.cache.delete(S.cache.keys().next().value);
        rememberRetainedResult_(retained,data);
        return data;
      }

      // Only read-only page data uses stale-while-revalidate. Forms, score
      // popups and mutations keep their existing fresh/version checks.
      function viewIdentity_() {
        return JSON.stringify([S.view,S.params,
          S.view==='database' ? listState :
          S.view==='programprogress' ? progressFilters_() :
          ['project','evidence'].includes(S.view) ? S.enrollmentId :
          S.view==='certificates' ? certPage : S.view==='qleap' ? qleapPage :
          S.view==='audit' ? S.auditBefore : null]);
      }
      async function viewResource_(name,args=[],ttl=30000,force=false) {
        args=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(args));
        const key=S.epoch+'|'+name+'|'+JSON.stringify(args),cached=S.cache.get(key);
        if(force || !cached || Date.now()-cached.ts>120000)
          return resource(name,args,ttl,force);
        if(Date.now()-cached.ts>=ttl) {
          let refresh=S.viewRefreshes.get(key);
          if(!refresh || (refresh.done && Date.now()-refresh.at>15000)) {
            refresh={epoch:S.epoch,generation:S.readGeneration,done:false};
            S.viewRefreshes.set(key,refresh);
            $('syncLabel').textContent='Memperbarui data…';
            const job=refresh;
            setTimeout(async()=>{
              try {
                if(job.epoch!==S.epoch || job.generation!==S.readGeneration ||
                  job.nav!==S.nav || job.scope!==viewIdentity_()) return;
                const rpcKey=S.epoch+'|'+S.readGeneration+'|'+name+'|'+JSON.stringify([S.token,...args]);
                S.backgroundReadKeys.add(rpcKey);
                const request=resource(name,args,ttl,true,{freshSource:false});
                S.backgroundReadKeys.delete(rpcKey);
                const refreshed=await request;
                if(job.epoch!==S.epoch || job.generation!==S.readGeneration ||
                  job.nav!==S.nav || job.scope!==viewIdentity_()) return;
                const active=document.activeElement,dialog=$('dialog');
                if(dialog.open || (active && /^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(active.tagName)) ||
                  (retainedViews.active && !canUpdateRetained_(retainedViews.active))) {
                  if(retainedViews.active) retainedViews.active.needsRender=true;
                  $('syncLabel').textContent='Data terbaru siap saat panel dibuka kembali';
                  return;
                }
                if(JSON.stringify(refreshed)!==JSON.stringify(cached.data))
                  await renderCurrentView_(S.nav,S.params,false);
                $('syncLabel').textContent='Data diperbarui';
              } catch(error) {
                if(job.epoch!==S.epoch || job.generation!==S.readGeneration || error.stale) return;
                if(/AUTH_/.test(String(error.message))) handleError(error);
                else if(job.nav===S.nav) $('syncLabel').textContent='Data terakhir ditampilkan · pembaruan belum berhasil';
              } finally {
                job.done=true;job.at=Date.now();
                if(job.epoch===S.epoch && (job.nav!==S.nav || job.scope!==viewIdentity_()))
                  S.viewRefreshes.delete(key);
              }
            },180);
          }
          refresh.nav=S.nav;refresh.scope=viewIdentity_();
        }
        rememberRetainedResult_(rememberRetainedRead_(name,args,ttl,{}),cached.data);
        return cached.data;
      }

      function invalidate(names) {
        S.readGeneration++;
        S.viewRefreshes.clear();
        if(names.some(n=>["getDashboard","getParticipantFullDetail","getParticipantPage","getSystemSettings"].includes(n))) {
          names=[...names,"getDashboardBootstrap","getParticipantDashboardData","getOverviewStats"];
          dashboardWork.at=0; dashboardWork.error="";dashboardWork.generation++;dashboardWork.promise=null;
        }
        if (names.some((n) => ["getParticipantPage", "getDashboard", "getParticipantFullDetail"].includes(n)))
          names = [...names, "getProgramProgress"];
        if(names.includes('getParticipantPage')) names=[...names,'getCertificatesOverview','getParticipantWorkspace','getQleapPostTestRecap','getMyQleapPostTest'];
        if(names.some(n=>['getSystemSettings','getQleapMappings'].includes(n)))
          names=[...names,'getQleapPostTestRecap','getMyQleapPostTest'];
        invalidateRetainedViews_(names);
        for (const key of S.cache.keys())
          if (names.some((n) => key.includes("|" + n + "|")))
            S.cache.delete(key);
      }
      function alive(nav) {

      function menus() {

            ["overview", "Overview", "home"],
            ["progress", "Progres Belajar", "book"],
            ["project", "Project", "folder"],
            ["evidence", "Mentoring", "people"],
            ["mycertificate", "Sertifikat", "award"],
            ["qleap", "Hasil QLEAP", "list"],
          ];
        let list = [
          ["segments", "Pilih Segmen", "home"],
            ["overview", "Overview", "home"],
          ["programprogress", "Progress Program", "list"],
          ["database", "Database Peserta", "people"],
        ];
        if (role === "ADMIN")
          list.push(
            ["users", "User dan Akses", "people"],
            ["rawimport", "Upload & Rekap", "upload"],
            ["qleapmodules", "Modul QLEAP", "book"],
            ["certificates", "Sertifikat", "award"],
          );
        if (role === "ADMIN" || role === "CLP")
          list.push(["qleap", "Hasil QLEAP", "book"]);
        if (role === "ADMIN")
          list.push(
            ["settings", "Pengaturan", "settings"],
            ["audit", "Riwayat Aktivitas", "list"],
          );
        return list;
      }
      function renderShell() {
        const u = S.dashboard.session;
        $("userName").textContent = u.name;
        $("userRole").textContent =
          ROLE_LABELS[u.role] + (u.region ? " · " + u.region : "") + (S.segment!=="ALL"?" · "+S.segment:"");
        $("avatar").textContent = String(u.name || "U")
          .split(/\s+/)
          .slice(0, 2)
          .map((x) => x[0])
          .join("");
        $("switchRole").hidden = (u.roles || []).length < 2;
        $("sidebarNav").innerHTML = menus()
          .map(
            ([id, label, i]) =>
              '<button type="button" class="nav-item ' +
              (S.view === id ? "active" : "") +
              '" data-action="navigate" data-view="' +
              id +
              '">' +
              icon(i) +
              "<span>" +
              esc(label) +
              "</span></button>",
          )
          .join("");
      }
      // No persistent browser storage: personal data stays in this signed-in tab.
      const dashboardWork = {epoch:-1,promise:null,at:0,generation:0,error:"",force:false};
      function applyDashboard_(d) {
        if(d.segment) S.segment=d.segment;
        S.dashboard=d; S.session=d.session;
        renderShell(); $("app").hidden=false; $("loginPage").hidden=true;
        $("syncLabel").textContent=d.detailsPending ? "Memuat ringkasan…" :
          "Diperbarui "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString("id-ID",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
        if(dashboardWork.epoch!==S.epoch) {
          Object.assign(dashboardWork,{epoch:S.epoch,promise:null,at:0,error:"",force:false});
        }
        if(d.summaryCached && !d.detailsPending) dashboardWork.at=Date.now();
        return d;
      }
      function dashboardNotice_() {
        if(dashboardWork.epoch===S.epoch && dashboardWork.error)
          return '<div class="notice amber" role="status">'+esc(dashboardWork.error)+' '+button('Coba lagi','retry-dashboard','','small')+'</div>';
        return S.dashboard.detailsPending ? '<div class="notice" role="status">Ringkasan sedang dimuat. Anda sudah bisa membuka menu lain.</div>'
          : S.dashboard.refreshing ? '<div class="notice" role="status">Memperbarui data…</div>' : '';
      }
      function startDashboardHydration_(force=false) {
        if(!S.dashboard || !S.token) return Promise.resolve();
        if(dashboardWork.epoch!==S.epoch) Object.assign(dashboardWork,{epoch:S.epoch,promise:null,at:0,error:"",force:false});
        const fresh=force || dashboardWork.force;
        if(dashboardWork.promise) return dashboardWork.promise;
        if(!fresh && dashboardWork.at && Date.now()-dashboardWork.at<30000) return Promise.resolve();
        // A failed load exposes a retry button, rather than retrying forever.
        if(dashboardWork.error && !fresh) return Promise.resolve();
        const epoch=S.epoch,generation=S.readGeneration,version=++dashboardWork.generation,
          participant=S.dashboard.session.role==='PARTICIPANT',
          endpoint=participant?'getParticipantDashboardData':'getOverviewStats';
        dashboardWork.error="";dashboardWork.force=false;
        const task=(async()=>{
          try {
            const d=await resource(endpoint,[{fresh:!!fresh}],30000,!!fresh);
            if(epoch!==S.epoch || generation!==S.readGeneration || version!==dashboardWork.generation || !S.dashboard) return;
            Object.assign(S.dashboard,d,{detailsPending:false,refreshing:false});
            markDashboardPanels_();
            dashboardWork.at=Date.now();
            $("syncLabel").textContent='Diperbarui '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
          } catch(e) {
            if(epoch!==S.epoch || generation!==S.readGeneration || version!==dashboardWork.generation || e.stale) return;
            if(/AUTH_/.test(String(e.message))) {handleError(e);return;}
            dashboardWork.error='Ringkasan belum berhasil dimuat. Silakan coba lagi.';
            S.dashboard.refreshing=false;
            $("syncLabel").textContent='Ringkasan belum dimuat';
          } finally {
            if(epoch===S.epoch && version===dashboardWork.generation) {
              dashboardWork.promise=null;
              if(S.token && ['overview','progress','mycertificate'].includes(S.view))
                renderCurrentView_(S.nav,S.params,false).catch(handleError);
            }
          }
        })();
        dashboardWork.promise=task;
        return task;
      }

      async function loadDashboard(force = false) {
        const previous=S.dashboard,
          d=await resource("getDashboardBootstrap",[],30000,force);
        if(previous && previous.session && d.session && !previous.detailsPending &&
          previous.session.nik===d.session.nik && previous.session.role===d.session.role &&
          previous.session.region===d.session.region && d.detailsPending) {
          if(d.session.role==='PARTICIPANT' && previous.programDashboards) d.programDashboards=previous.programDashboards;
          if(d.session.role!=='PARTICIPANT' && previous.programStats) {d.programStats=previous.programStats;d.programStatsPending=false;}
          d.detailsPending=false;d.refreshing=true;
        }
        if(force) {
          dashboardWork.generation++;dashboardWork.promise=null;dashboardWork.at=0;
          dashboardWork.error="";dashboardWork.force=true;
        }
        return applyDashboard_(d);
      }
      // Keep actual elements and their listeners, not serialized HTML copies.
      // Only the active root is attached, so existing IDs stay unambiguous.
      const retainedViews={epoch:-1,sequence:0,pages:new Map(),active:null};
      const retainedDependencies={
        overview:['getDashboardBootstrap','getOverviewStats','getParticipantDashboardData'],
        progress:['getDashboardBootstrap','getParticipantDashboardData'],
        mycertificate:['getDashboardBootstrap','getParticipantDashboardData'],
        database:['getParticipantPage'],
        programprogress:['getProgramProgress'],detail:['getParticipantFullDetail'],
        project:['getParticipantWorkspace'],evidence:['getParticipantWorkspace'],
        certificates:['getCertificatesOverview'],users:['getUserAccountsPage'],
        qleap:['getQleapPostTestRecap','getMyQleapPostTest'],
        settings:['getSystemSettings'],audit:['getAuditPage'],
        rawimport:['getRawImportOptions','getRawImportHistory'],
        qleapmodules:['getRawImportOptions'],legacy:['getMigrationIssues']
      };
      function retainedKey_(view,params) {
        if(view==='rawimport') params={program:params.program || rawImportState.selected?.program || 'TSHDP'};
        if(view==='qleapmodules') params={program:params.program || moduleLinkState.program,phase:params.phase || moduleLinkState.phase};
        const scope=view==='database' ? listState :
          view==='programprogress' ? progressFilters_() :
          ['project','evidence'].includes(view) ? S.enrollmentId :
          view==='users' ? userPage : view==='certificates' ? certPage :
          view==='qleap' ? qleapPage : view==='audit' ? S.auditBefore : null;
        return JSON.stringify([S.epoch,view,params,scope]);
      }
      function syncRetainedFormScope_(view,params) {
        const p=retainedViews.active;
        if(!p || p.view!==view || !alive(p.nav)) return;
        if(retainedViews.pages.get(p.key)===p) retainedViews.pages.delete(p.key);
        S.params=params;p.params=params;p.key=retainedKey_(view,params);
        retainedViews.pages.set(p.key,p);
      }
      function clearRetainedViews_() {
        stopCertificateRefresh_();
        if(retainedViews.pages.size) {
          const host=$('content');if(host && host.replaceChildren) host.replaceChildren();
        }
        retainedViews.pages.clear();retainedViews.active=null;retainedViews.epoch=S.epoch;
      }
      function nextRetainedNav_() {
        retainedViews.sequence=Math.max(retainedViews.sequence,S.nav)+1;
        return retainedViews.sequence;
      }
      function retainedState_() {
        return {rows:S.rows,pageData:S.pageData,workspace:S.workspace,auditNext:S.auditNext};
      }
      function rememberRetainedRead_(name,args,ttl,options) {
        const p=retainedViews.active;
        if(!p || p.epoch!==S.epoch || p.view!==S.view ||
          options.retainedBackground || !(retainedDependencies[p.view] || []).includes(name)) return null;
        const key=retainedKey_(S.view,S.params);
        if(p.key!==key) {
          if(retainedViews.pages.get(p.key)===p) retainedViews.pages.delete(p.key);
          const other=retainedViews.pages.get(key);if(other && other!==p) other.el.remove();
          p.key=key;p.reads.clear();retainedViews.pages.set(key,p);
        }
        const readKey=S.epoch+'|'+name+'|'+JSON.stringify(args),
          read={key:readKey,name,args,ttl,snapshot:null};
        p.reads.set(readKey,read);
        return {page:p,read,nav:p.nav};
      }
      function rememberRetainedResult_(ticket,data) {
        if(!ticket) return;
        const {page:p,read,nav}=ticket;
        if(p.epoch!==S.epoch || p.nav!==nav || p.reads.get(read.key)!==read) return;
        read.snapshot=JSON.stringify(data);
        if(retainedViews.active!==p || !alive(nav)) p.needsRender=true;
      }
      function invalidateRetainedViews_(names) {
        for(const p of retainedViews.pages.values())
          if((retainedDependencies[p.view] || []).some(n=>names.includes(n))) p.dirty=true;
      }
      function markDashboardPanels_() {
        for(const p of retainedViews.pages.values())
          if(['overview','progress','mycertificate'].includes(p.view)) p.needsRender=true;
      }
      function canUpdateRetained_(p) {
        const focus=document.activeElement;
        return !p.edited && !$('dialog').open &&
          !(focus && p.el.contains(focus) && /^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(focus.tagName));
      }
      async function renderCurrentView_(nav,params,force) {
        const p=retainedViews.active,view=S.view,generation=S.readGeneration;
        await renderers[view](nav,params,force);
        if(p && p===retainedViews.active && alive(nav) && generation===S.readGeneration) {
          p.ready=true;p.dirty=false;p.needsRender=false;p.state=retainedState_();
        }
      }
      function trimRetainedViews_() {
        for(const [key,p] of retainedViews.pages) {
          if(retainedViews.pages.size<=16) break;
          if(p===retainedViews.active || p.edited ||
            (p.view==='rawimport' && typeof rawImportState!=='undefined' && rawImportState.running)) continue;
          p.el.remove();retainedViews.pages.delete(key);
        }
      }
      function refreshRetainedView_(p) {
        if(['overview','progress','mycertificate'].includes(p.view)) {
          startDashboardHydration_();return;
        }
        if(p.refreshing || p.dirty || p.edited || Date.now()-(p.refreshAt || 0)<15000) return;
        const reads=[...p.reads.values()].filter(r=>{
          const c=S.cache.get(r.key);return !c || Date.now()-c.ts>=r.ttl;
        });
        if(!reads.length) return;
        p.refreshing=true;
        setTimeout(async()=>{
          const epoch=S.epoch,generation=S.readGeneration,nav=p.nav,route=p.key;
          try {
            if(retainedViews.active!==p || !alive(nav) || p.dirty || p.edited) return;
            $('syncLabel').textContent='Memperbarui data…';
            for(const r of reads) {
              if(retainedViews.active!==p || !alive(nav)) break;
              const key=epoch+'|'+generation+'|'+r.name+'|'+JSON.stringify([S.token,...r.args]);
              S.backgroundReadKeys.add(key);
              const request=resource(r.name,r.args,r.ttl,true,{freshSource:false,retainedBackground:true});
              S.backgroundReadKeys.delete(key);
              const data=await request;
              if(epoch!==S.epoch || generation!==S.readGeneration || p.nav!==nav || p.key!==route) return;
              if(JSON.stringify(data)!==r.snapshot) p.needsRender=true;

            if(retainedViews.active!==p || !alive(nav)) return;
            if(p.needsRender && canUpdateRetained_(p)) await renderCurrentView_(nav,S.params,false);
            $('syncLabel').textContent=p.needsRender ? 'Data terbaru siap · Muat ulang saat selesai mengisi' : 'Data diperbarui';
          } catch(e) {
            if(epoch!==S.epoch || generation!==S.readGeneration || e.stale) return;
            if(/AUTH_/.test(String(e.message))) handleError(e);
            else if(retainedViews.active===p) $('syncLabel').textContent='Data terakhir ditampilkan · pembaruan belum berhasil';
          } finally {p.refreshing=false;p.refreshAt=Date.now();}
        },180);
      }
      async function navigateRetained_(view,params,force) {
        if(retainedViews.epoch!==S.epoch) clearRetainedViews_();
        const previous=retainedViews.active;
        if(previous) {previous.state=retainedState_();previous.scroll=window.scrollY || 0;previous.el.hidden=true;}
        const key=retainedKey_(view,params);
        if(previous && previous.view===view && previous.key!==key &&
          ['database','users','certificates','qleap','audit','programprogress'].includes(view)) {
          retainedViews.pages.delete(previous.key);
        }
        let p=retainedViews.pages.get(key);
        if(!p) {
          if(['rawimport','qleapmodules'].includes(view))
            for(const [oldKey,old] of retainedViews.pages)
              if(old.view===view) {old.el.remove();retainedViews.pages.delete(oldKey);}
          const el=document.createElement('div');el.setAttribute('data-ldp-view',view);
          p={key,view,params,el,epoch:S.epoch,nav:nextRetainedNav_(),reads:new Map(),ready:false,dirty:false,edited:false};
          for(const event of ['input','change']) el.addEventListener(event,e=>{
            if(e.target && (e.target.type==='file' || e.target.closest('form'))) {
              p.edited=true;p.editVersion=(p.editVersion || 0)+1;
            }
          });
          retainedViews.pages.set(key,p);
        }
        retainedViews.pages.delete(key);retainedViews.pages.set(key,p);
        retainedViews.active=p;S.nav=p.nav;S.view=view;S.params=params;
        $('pageLabel').textContent=LABELS[view] || view;
        $('sidebar').classList.remove('open');$('sidebarBackdrop').classList.remove('open');
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('active',el.dataset.view===view));
        const host=$('content');if(host.firstElementChild!==p.el) host.replaceChildren(p.el);p.el.hidden=false;
        host.inert=false;host.setAttribute('aria-busy','false');

            p.el.querySelectorAll('[data-select]').forEach(el=>el.checked=S.selected.has(el.dataset.select));
            const all=$('selectPage');if(all) all.checked=(S.rows || []).every(r=>S.selected.has(r.enrollmentId));
            selectionLabel();
          }
          if(p.edited && p.dirty) $('syncLabel').textContent='Data berubah · input yang belum disimpan tetap tersimpan';
          if(view==='certificates') scheduleCertificateRefresh_(p.nav,{rows:S.rows});

        if(fresh) {p.nav=nextRetainedNav_();S.nav=p.nav;p.reads.clear();p.edited=false;p.dirty=false;}
