      async function navigate(view, params = {}, force = false) {
        if(S.segment==="ALL" && view!=="segments") view="segments";
        // Older links use the same Database root, state and request cache.
        if(view === "control") view = "database";
        if(view !== "certificates") stopCertificateRefresh_();
        if(view === "database" && params.program) {
          if(params.program !== listState.program) {
            listState.program=params.program;listState.batch="";listState.page=1;S.selected.clear();
          }
          params={...params};delete params.program;
        }
        if(typeof $("content").replaceChildren==='function') return navigateRetained_(view,params,force);
        const nav = ++S.nav;
        S.view = view;
        S.params = params;
        $("pageLabel").textContent = LABELS[view] || view;
        $("sidebar").classList.remove("open");
        $("sidebarBackdrop").classList.remove("open");
        document
          .querySelectorAll(".nav-item")
          .forEach((el) =>
            el.classList.toggle("active", el.dataset.view === view),
          );
        const host=$('content');
        host.inert=true;host.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
        // A cache hit renders in this turn, with no intermediate loading page.
        // Cold reads get the destination heading while the request continues.
        const placeholder=setTimeout(()=>{
          if(alive(nav) && S.paintedNav!==nav)
            content(pageHead(LABELS[view] || view,'')+loading());
        },100);
        try {
          await renderers[view](nav, params, force);
        } catch (e) {
          if (alive(nav) && !e.stale) {
            if (/AUTH_/.test(e.message)) handleError(e);
            else errorScreen(e);
          }
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(placeholder);
          if(alive(nav)) {host.inert=false;host.setAttribute('aria-busy','false');}
        }
      }
      function metric(label, value, sub = "") {
        return (
          '<div class="card"><div class="metric-label">' +
          esc(label) +
          '</div><div class="metric mono">' +
          fmt(value) +
          '</div><div class="metric-sub">' +
          esc(sub) +
          "</div></div>"
        );
      }
      function phaseCard(e, stage) {
        if (stage.stage === "PANELISASI") {
          return participantScoreCard_(e, "Panelisasi", e.panelScore, {
            action: "panel-detail", hint: "Lihat nilai & feedback panelis", status: stage.status,
          });
        }
        const p =
            stage.stage === "PHASE 1"
              ? e.phase1
              : stage.stage === "PHASE 2"
                ? e.phase2
                : stage.stage === "PHASE 3"
                  ? e.phase3
                  : null,
          can = ["PHASE 1", "PHASE 2", "PHASE 3"].includes(stage.stage),
          tag = can ? "button" : "div";
        return (
          "<" +
          tag +
          (can
            ? ' type="button" data-action="assessment" ' +
              attrTarget(e) +
              ' data-phase="' +
              stage.stage +
              '"'
            : "") +
          ' class="phase ' +
          (stage.status === "COMPLETED"
            ? "done"
            : stage.status === "ON GOING"
              ? "current"
              : "") +
          '"><div class="phase-name">' +
          esc(stage.stage.replace("PHASE", "Phase")) +
          (can ? icon("arrow") : "") +
          "</div>" +
          badge(
            stage.status === "ON GOING"
              ? "Berlangsung"
              : stage.status === "COMPLETED"
                ? "COMPLETED"
                : "Belum dimulai",
          ) +
          '<div class="phase-score mono">' +
          (e.detailsPending ? 'Memuat…' : p && p.error ? 'Coba lagi' : fmt(p && p.score)) +
          '</div>' +
          (p && p.remedials && p.remedials.length ? '<small style="color:var(--red);display:block;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:5px">' + p.remedials.length + ' remedial</small>' : '') +
          '<span class="muted">' +
          (can
            ? stage.stage === "PHASE 3" ? "Lihat nilai Phase 3" : "Lihat detail kompetensi"
            : stage.stage === "PANELISASI"
              ? "Tahap panelisasi"
              : "Nilai phase") +
          "</span></" +
          tag +
          ">"
        );
      }
      function participantScoreCard_(e, label, value, options = {}) {
        const hasScore = value !== "" && value !== null && value !== undefined,
          completed = !e.detailsPending && hasScore,
          status = e.detailsPending ? "Memuat…" : options.final
            ? e.result || (hasScore ? "Tersedia" : "ON GOING")
            : completed ? "COMPLETED" : options.status === "ON GOING" ? "Berlangsung" : "Belum tersedia",
          tag = options.action ? "button" : "div";
        return "<" + tag + (options.action
          ? ' type="button" data-action="' + esc(options.action) + '" ' + attrTarget(e)
          : '') + ' class="phase' + (options.secondary ? ' score-secondary' : '') +
          (completed ? ' done' : '') + '"><div class="phase-name">' + esc(label) +
          (options.action ? icon("arrow") : '') + '</div>' + badge(status) +
          '<div class="phase-score mono">' + (e.detailsPending ? 'Memuat…' : fmt(value)) +
          '</div><span class="muted">' + esc(options.hint || '') + '</span></' + tag + '>';
      }
      function participantCertificateCard_(e) {
        const url = safeUrl(e.certificateUrl),
          message = url ? "Sertifikat program sudah tersedia."
            : e.detailsPending ? "Memuat informasi sertifikat…"
            : "Sertifikat belum tersedia. Sertifikat dapat diunduh setelah dipublikasikan oleh Admin.";
        return '<section class="program-certificate" aria-label="Sertifikat program"><div><h3>Sertifikat</h3><p class="muted">' +
          esc(message) + '</p></div>' + (url
            ? '<a class="btn primary" href="' + url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Unduh sertifikat</a>'
            : '<button type="button" class="btn" disabled>' + (e.detailsPending ? 'Memuat…' : 'Belum tersedia') + '</button>') + '</section>';
      }
      function programCard(e, nik) {
        e = Object.assign({ nik }, e);
        const stages = e.progressStages || [];
        return (
          '<section class="card"><div class="program-header"><div><span class="program-tag">' +
          esc(e.program) +
          "</span><h2>" +
          esc(e.program) +
          ' Development Program</h2><div class="program-meta">' +
          esc(e.batch) +
          " · " +
          esc(e.region || "") +
          "</div></div>" +
          badge(e.result) +
          '</div><div class="progress-grid participant-scores">' +
          ["PHASE 1", "PHASE 2", "PHASE 3", "PANELISASI"].map((stage) =>
            phaseCard(e, stages.find((x) => x.stage === stage) || { stage, status: "NOT STARTED" })
          ).join("") +
          participantScoreCard_(e, "Behavior · " +
            (e.behaviourScale === 100 || Number(e.behaviourObservation) > 5 ? "0–100" : "1–5"),
            e.behaviourObservation, { action: "behavior", hint: "Lihat observasi", secondary: true }) +
          participantScoreCard_(e, "Nilai Final", e.finalScore, {
            final: true, secondary: true, hint: e.finalScore !== "" && e.finalScore != null
              ? "Nilai akhir program · batas kelulusan 80" : "Menunggu semua komponen nilai lengkap",
          }) +
          '</div>' +

          historicalCard_(e) +

            ? '<div class="actions" style="margin-top:20px">' +

              button("Ubah status peserta", "status", attrTarget(e), "small") +
              "</div>"
            : "") +
          participantCertificateCard_(e) +
          "</section>"
        );
      }
      async function renderOverview(nav, params, force) {
        if (force) await loadDashboard(true);

        const d = S.dashboard;

          const p = d.participant;
          content(

              "Halo, " + String(p.name).split(" ")[0],

            ) +
              dashboardNotice_() +
              (d.programDashboards || [])
                .map((e) => programCard(e, p.nik))
                .join(""),
          );

          return;
        }
        if(d.programStatsPending) {
          content('<h1 style="font-size:24px;color:#07152e;margin-bottom:22px;">Ringkasan Program</h1>'+dashboardNotice_()+
            '<div class="talent-program-stack">'+segmentPrograms_().map(program=>
              '<section class="talent-program-card '+(program==='TSHDP'?'tshdp':'')+'"><div class="talent-program-name">'+program+
              '</div>'+(dashboardWork.error ? '<p class="muted">Ringkasan belum tersedia. Gunakan Coba lagi di atas.</p>'
                : '<p class="muted">Memuat ringkasan program…</p>'+loading())+'</section>').join('')+'</div>');
          startDashboardHydration_();return;
        }
        const stats = (d.programStats || []).filter((g) => segmentPrograms_().includes(g.program));
        content(

          dashboardNotice_() + '<div class="talent-program-stack">' + stats.map(finalProgramPanel_).join("") + '</div>',
        );
        startDashboardHydration_();
      }
      function finalProgramPanel_(g) {
    var total = Number(g.total || 0);
    var denom = total || 1;
    var passed = Number(g.passed || 0);
    var onGoing = Number(g.onGoing || 0);
    var notPassed = Number(g.notPassed || 0);
    var passedPct = (passed / denom) * 100;
    var ongoingPct = (onGoing / denom) * 100;
    var failedPct = (notPassed / denom) * 100;
    var regionCount = Number(g.regionCount || (g.regionList || []).length || 0);

    function displayRegionLabel_(value) {
      var raw = String(value || '').trim();
      var m = raw.match(/^REGION\s+(\d+)$/i);
      return m ? ('Region ' + m[1]) : raw.replace(/\b\w/g, function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); });
    }

    var regions = (g.regionList || []).map(function (r) {
      var regionLabel = displayRegionLabel_(r.region);
      return '<button class="talent-region-chip" data-action="program-filter" data-program="' + esc(g.program) + '" data-region="' + esc(r.region) + '" title="Lihat peserta ' + esc(regionLabel) + '">' +
        '<span>' + esc(regionLabel) + '</span><span class="talent-region-count">' + Number(r.count || 0) + '</span></button>';
    }).join('');

    var metrics =
      '<div class="talent-metrics">' +
        '<button type="button" class="talent-metric talent-metric-link" data-action="program-filter" data-program="' + esc(g.program) + '" data-track="TALENT" aria-label="Lihat peserta Talent ' + esc(g.program) + '"><div class="talent-metric-label">Talent Pool</div><div class="talent-metric-value">' + Number(g.talentPool || 0) + '</div><div class="talent-metric-sub">Peserta berlabel Talent</div></button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="talent-metric talent-metric-link" data-action="program-filter" data-program="' + esc(g.program) + '" data-track="STANDARDISASI" aria-label="Lihat peserta Standarisasi ' + esc(g.program) + '"><div class="talent-metric-label">Standarisasi</div><div class="talent-metric-value">' + Number(g.standarisasi || 0) + '</div><div class="talent-metric-sub">Peserta berlabel Standarisasi</div></button>' +
        '<div class="talent-metric"><div class="talent-metric-label">Promosi</div><div class="talent-metric-value green">' + Number(g.promoted || 0) + '</div><div class="talent-metric-sub">' + (total ? Math.round(Number(g.promoted || 0) / total * 100) : 0) + '% dari total</div></div>' +
        '<div class="talent-metric"><div class="talent-metric-label">Resign</div><div class="talent-metric-value red">' + Number(g.resigned || 0) + '</div><div class="talent-metric-sub">' + (total ? Math.round(Number(g.resigned || 0) / total * 100) : 0) + '% dari total</div></div>' +
        '<button type="button" class="talent-metric talent-metric-link" data-action="program-filter" data-program="' + esc(g.program) + '" data-status="BYPASS" aria-label="Lihat peserta Bypass ' + esc(g.program) + '"><div class="talent-metric-label">Bypass</div><div class="talent-metric-value blue">' + Number(g.bypassed || 0) + '</div><div class="talent-metric-sub">Status peserta</div></button>' +
        '<div class="talent-metric"><div class="talent-metric-label">On Going</div><div class="talent-metric-value blue">' + onGoing + '</div><div class="talent-metric-sub">' + Number(g.eligiblePanel || 0) + ' eligible panel</div></div>' +
      '</div>';

    var progress =
      '<div class="talent-progress" aria-label="Komposisi hasil program">' +
        '<span class="talent-progress-passed" style="width:' + passedPct.toFixed(2) + '%"></span>' +
        '<span class="talent-progress-ongoing" style="width:' + ongoingPct.toFixed(2) + '%"></span>' +
        '<span class="talent-progress-failed" style="width:' + failedPct.toFixed(2) + '%"></span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="talent-legend">' +
        '<span class="talent-legend-item"><i class="talent-dot green"></i>Lulus ' + passed + ' (' + Number(g.passRate || 0) + '%)</span>' +
        '<span class="talent-legend-item"><i class="talent-dot blue"></i>On Going ' + onGoing + '</span>' +
        '<span class="talent-legend-item"><i class="talent-dot red"></i>Tidak Lulus ' + notPassed + '</span>' +
        '<span class="talent-legend-item"><i class="talent-dot navy"></i>Sertifikat terbit ' + Number(g.certified || 0) + '</span>' +
      '</div>';

    return '<div class="talent-program-card' + (g.program === 'TSHDP' ? ' tshdp' : '') + '">' +
      '<div class="talent-program-head">' +
        '<div><div class="talent-program-name">' + esc(g.program) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="talent-program-meta">' + total + ' peserta &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; ' + regionCount + ' region</div></div>' +
        '<button class="talent-program-open" data-action="program-filter" data-program="' + esc(g.program) + '" data-region="">Lihat Peserta</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      metrics +
      (Number(g.bothTracks || 0) ? '<p class="talent-track-note">' + Number(g.bothTracks) + ' peserta berlabel Keduanya tercatat di Talent Pool dan Standarisasi.</p>' : '') +
      (Number(g.unassignedTrack || 0) ? '<p class="talent-track-note">' + Number(g.unassignedTrack) + ' peserta belum ditetapkan jalurnya. ' + button('Lihat peserta','program-filter','data-program="'+esc(g.program)+'" data-track="UNASSIGNED"','small') + '</p>' : '') +
      progress +
      '<div class="talent-region-wrap"><div class="talent-region-title">Region</div><div class="talent-region-list">' +
      (regions || '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;">Belum ada data region.</span>') +
      '</div></div></div>';
  }


      // Each program retains independent cohort, participant and paging filters.
      const programProgressState = {epoch:-1, programs:{}, sequence:0};
      function progressFilters_() {
        if(programProgressState.epoch !== S.epoch) {
          programProgressState.epoch=S.epoch;
          programProgressState.programs={};
        }
        for(const p of segmentPrograms_())
          if(!programProgressState.programs[p]) programProgressState.programs[p]={batch:"",batchStatus:"",region:"",progressStatus:"",search:"",page:1};
        return programProgressState.programs;
      }
      function progressLabel_(status) {
        return status === "COMPLETE" ? "Complete" : status === "STOPPED" ? "Berhenti" : "On Going";
      }
      function programProgressPanel_(d) {
        const p=d.program, f=progressFilters_()[p], sum=d.summary,
          opts=(items)=>items.map(([value,label])=>'<option value="'+esc(value)+'">'+esc(label)+'</option>').join(''),
          field=(key,label,items)=>'<label>'+esc(label)+'<select id="pp_'+p+'_'+key+'">'+opts(items)+'</select></label>';
        return '<div class="program-progress-heading"><div><span class="program-tag">'+esc(p)+'</span><h2>Progress '+esc(p)+'</h2></div><span class="muted">'+sum.total+' keikutsertaan program</span></div>'+
          '<div class="program-progress-filters">'+
          field('batchStatus','Status batch',[["","Semua status batch"],["ON GOING","Batch On Going"],["COMPLETE","Batch Complete"],["STOPPED","Batch Berhenti"]])+
          field('batch','Batch',[["","Semua batch"],...(d.batches || []).map(b=>[b.batch,(b.batch || 'Tanpa batch')+' · '+progressLabel_(b.status)])])+
          field('region','Region',[["","Semua region"],...(d.regions || []).map(r=>[r,r])])+
          field('progressStatus','Status program peserta',[["","Semua peserta"],["ON GOING","On Going"],["COMPLETE","Complete"],["STOPPED","Berhenti"]])+
          '<label>Cari peserta<input id="pp_'+p+'_search" value="'+esc(f.search)+'" placeholder="Nama atau NIK…"></label></div>'+
          '<div class="program-progress-metrics">'+[['','Total',sum.total],['ON GOING','On Going',sum.onGoing],['COMPLETE','Complete',sum.complete],['STOPPED','Berhenti',sum.stopped]].map(([status,label,n])=>
            '<button type="button" class="program-progress-metric '+(f.progressStatus===status?'selected':'')+'" data-action="progress-status" data-program="'+p+'" data-status="'+status+'" aria-pressed="'+(f.progressStatus===status)+'"><span>'+label+'</span><strong>'+n+'</strong></button>').join('')+'</div>'+
          '<div class="program-progress-completion"><span>Complete '+sum.completionRate+'%</span><div class="program-progress-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="Penyelesaian '+p+'" aria-valuenow="'+sum.completionRate+'" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"><span style="width:'+sum.completionRate+'%"></span></div></div>'+
          (d.rows.length ? table(['Peserta','Batch / Region','Phase','Status program','Hasil akhir','Status peserta',''],d.rows.map(r=>'<tr><td><strong>'+esc(r.name)+'</strong><div class="muted mono">'+esc(r.nik)+'</div><div class="muted">'+esc(r.jobTitle)+'</div></td><td>'+fmt(r.batch)+'<div class="muted">'+fmt(r.region)+'</div></td><td>'+fmt(r.currentPhase)+'</td><td>'+badge(progressLabel_(r.progressStatus))+'</td><td>'+badge(r.result==='ON GOING'?'Nilai belum lengkap':r.result)+'</td><td>'+badge(r.participantStatus)+'</td><td>'+button('Lihat detail','progress-detail','data-nik="'+esc(r.nik)+'" data-program="'+p+'" data-batch="'+esc(r.batch)+'"','small')+'</td></tr>').join(''),
            '<div class="pagination"><span>'+d.total+' hasil · Halaman '+d.page+' dari '+d.pages+'</span><div class="actions">'+button('Sebelumnya','progress-page','data-program="'+p+'" data-page="'+(d.page-1)+'" '+(d.page<=1?'disabled':''),'small')+button('Berikutnya','progress-page','data-program="'+p+'" data-page="'+(d.page+1)+'" '+(d.page>=d.pages?'disabled':''),'small')+'</div></div>') : empty('Peserta tidak ditemukan','Coba batch, status, region, atau kata kunci lain.'));
      }
      async function renderProgramProgress(nav, params, force) {
        if(!["ADMIN","CLP","SUPERIOR"].includes(S.dashboard.session.role))
          throw new Error("Panel ini hanya tersedia untuk pengelola program.");
        progressFilters_();
        content(pageHead('Progress Program','Pantau angkatan berjalan dan riwayat peserta pada segmen aktif.')+
          '<div class="notice">Complete mengikuti phase COMPLETED atau hasil akhir program yang sudah lengkap. Status kelulusan dan status peserta tetap ditampilkan terpisah. Status batch mengikuti peserta yang tercatat dalam akses Anda.</div>'+
          '<div class="program-progress-stack">'+segmentPrograms_().map(p=>'<section class="card program-progress-panel '+p.toLowerCase()+'" id="pp_'+p+'">'+loading()+'</section>').join('')+'</div>');
        await loadProgramProgress_(nav,force);
      }
      async function loadProgramProgress_(nav, force=false) {
        const owner=retainedViews.active,
          sequence=owner ? (owner.progressSequence=(owner.progressSequence || 0)+1) : ++programProgressState.sequence,
          programs=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(progressFilters_()));
        const d=await viewResource_('getProgramProgress',[{programs}],30000,force);
        if(!alive(nav) || S.view!=='programprogress' || sequence!==(owner ? owner.progressSequence : programProgressState.sequence)) return;
        const active=document.activeElement,
          focus=active && /^pp_(ASHDP|TSHDP|SLDP)_/.test(active.id || '') ?
            {id:active.id,start:active.selectionStart,end:active.selectionEnd} : null;
        for(const panel of d.programs || []) {
          const p=panel.program;
          if(!segmentPrograms_().includes(p)) continue;
          const f=progressFilters_()[p]; f.page=panel.page;
          $('pp_'+p).innerHTML=programProgressPanel_(panel);
          for(const key of ['batchStatus','batch','region','progressStatus']) {
            const el=$('pp_'+p+'_'+key); el.value=f[key];
            el.addEventListener('change',()=>{
              if(!alive(nav) || S.view!=='programprogress') return;
              f[key]=el.value; f.page=1;
              if(key==='batchStatus' || key==='region') f.batch='';
              loadProgramProgress_(nav).catch(handleError);
            });
          }
          let debounce;
          const search=$('pp_'+p+'_search');
          search.addEventListener('input',()=>{
            clearTimeout(debounce);
            f.search=search.value; f.page=1;
            programProgressState.sequence++;
            if(owner) owner.progressSequence=(owner.progressSequence || 0)+1;
            debounce=setTimeout(()=>{
              if(!alive(nav) || S.view!=='programprogress') return;
              loadProgramProgress_(nav).catch(handleError);
            },300);
          });
        }
        if(focus) {
          const el=$(focus.id);
          if(el) {el.focus(); if(el.setSelectionRange && focus.start!=null) el.setSelectionRange(focus.start,focus.end);}
        }
      }
      function filterProgress_(program, status, page) {
        if(!segmentPrograms_().includes(program)) return;
        const f=progressFilters_()[program];
        if(status!==undefined) { f.progressStatus=status; f.page=1; }
        if(page!==undefined) f.page=Math.max(1,Number(page)||1);
        return loadProgramProgress_(S.nav);
      }


      async function renderProgress(nav,params,force) {
        if(force) await loadDashboard(true);
        if(!alive(nav)) return;
        content(
          pageHead(
            "Progres Belajar",
              "Lihat rincian kompetensi Phase 1–2, nilai Phase 3, dan modul remedial.",
          ) +
            dashboardNotice_() +
            (S.dashboard.programDashboards || [])
              .map((e) => programCard(e, S.dashboard.participant.nik))
              .join(""),
        );
        startDashboardHydration_();
      }
      async function renderDetail(nav, params, force) {

        );
        if (!alive(nav)) return;
        const p = d.participant;
        content(

            button(

              "navigate",
              'data-view="' + (params.from === "programprogress" ? "programprogress" : "database") + '"',
            ),
          ) +

            [
              ["NIK", p.NIK],
              ["Jabatan", p.JobTitle],
              ["Lokasi", p.Location],
              ["Kota", p.CityName],
            ]
              .map(
                ([l, v]) =>
                  "<div><label>" +
                  esc(l) +

              .join("") +
            "</div></section>" +

              return Number(selected(b))-Number(selected(a));

        );
      }
      async function assessment(t, phase, editing = false) {
        const serial = modal("Detail Nilai", t.program + " · " + t.batch + " · " + phase.replace("PHASE", "Phase"), loading());
        try {
          const a = await resource("getParticipantAssessmentDetail", [t.nik, phase, t.program, t.batch], 120000, true);
          if (serial !== S.modal) return;
          const admin = S.dashboard.session.role === "ADMIN",
            mods = a.modules || [],
            canEdit = admin && a.editable !== false && mods.some((m) => m.editable !== false),
            edit = canEdit,
            remedials = mods.filter((m) => m.result === "REMEDIAL REQUIRED"),
            weighted = mods.some((m) => m.weight != null);
          $("modalContent").innerHTML =
            '<div class="modal-header"><div><h2>' + esc(t.program + " " + phase + " - Detail Nilai") +
            '</h2><p>' + esc(t.batch) + ' · lookup berdasarkan NIK peserta.</p></div><button type="button" class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" aria-label="Tutup">×</button></div>' +
            (a.participantFallback ? '<div class="notice">Nilai diambil dari Participant karena rincian tahap ini belum tersedia untuk batch tersebut. Total: <strong>'+fmt(a.averageScore)+'</strong>. Nilai per kompetensi tidak dibuat dari total.</div>' : '') +
            (a.historicalScore !== undefined ? '<div class="notice">Total historis: <strong>'+fmt(a.historicalScore)+'</strong>. '+(a.historicalOnly?'Unggah file mentah untuk melengkapi rincian kompetensi.':'Nilai rincian sumber: '+fmt(a.sourceAverageScore)+'. Total historis tetap dipertahankan sampai Admin mengoreksi atau mengganti aturan penilaian.')+'</div>' : '') +
            (!a.available ? '<div class="notice">' + esc(admin ? a.message || "Nilai belum tersedia." : "Nilai belum tersedia untuk program dan batch ini.") + '</div>' : '') +
            (a.breakdownNote ? '<div class="notice">'+esc(a.breakdownNote)+'</div>' : '') +
            '<form id="assessmentForm" class="assessment-view"><table class="assessment-table"><colgroup><col class="competency-col"><col class="score-col"><col class="status-col"></colgroup><thead><tr><th>Kompetensi / Module</th><th>Nilai</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
            mods.map((m, i) => '<tr><td>' + esc(m.displayLabel || m.module) +
              (m.weight == null ? '' : '<small class="muted">Bobot ' + Math.round(m.weight * 100) + '%</small>') +
              '</td><td>' + (edit && m.editable !== false
                ? '<input id="assessmentScore_' + i + '" aria-label="Nilai ' + esc(m.module) + '" name="score_' + i + '" class="assessment-score-input" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.01" value="' + esc(m.score) + '">'
                : '<span class="assessment-static-score">' + fmt(m.score) + '</span>') +
              '</td><td>' + badge(m.result) + '</td></tr>').join('') +
            '</tbody></table><div class="assessment-average"><span>' + (a.participantFallback ? 'Total dari Participant' : a.historicalScore !== undefined ? 'Total historis' : weighted ? 'Nilai akhir berbobot' : 'Average Score') + '</span><strong>' + fmt(a.averageScore) +
            '</strong><span class="muted">Passing standard ' + fmt(a.passingScore) + '</span></div>' +
            (remedials.length ? '<section class="assessment-remedial-block"><h3>Remedial yang wajib diselesaikan</h3>' + remedials.map((m) => {
              const url=safeUrl(m.qleapUrl);
              return '<div class="remedial-row"><div><strong>' + esc(m.module) + '</strong><small>Nilai: ' + fmt(m.score) + ' · Minimum: ' + fmt(a.passingScore) + '</small></div>' +
                (url ? '<a class="btn primary" href="' + url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Buka Modul QLEAP</a>'
                  : '<span class="muted">Link remedial belum ditambahkan.</span>') + '</div>';
            }).join('') + '</section>' : '') +
            (Object.keys(a.answers||{}).length ? '<details><summary>Jawaban Form Phase 3</summary>'+table(['Pertanyaan','Jawaban'],Object.entries(a.answers).map(([q,v])=>'<tr><td class="wrap">'+esc(q)+'</td><td class="wrap">'+esc(v)+'</td></tr>').join(''))+'</details>' : '') +
            (edit ? '<div class="assessment-save"><button type="submit" class="btn primary">Save Changes</button>'+(a.hasManualOverrides?button("Lepas proteksi koreksi","release-override",attrTarget({...t,recordVersion:a.recordVersion})+' data-phase="'+esc(phase)+'" data-version="'+esc(a.recordVersion)+'"'):'')+'</div>' : '') + '</form>';
          if (edit) form("assessmentForm", async (data) => {
            const res = await rpc("saveAssessmentScores", S.token, {

            });

            closeModal(); toast(res.message);
            if (S.view === "detail") navigate("detail", S.params, true);
          });
        } catch (e) {

      // Paginated participant lists share one renderer and keep filtering on the server.

      let listSequence = 0;
      async function renderDatabase(nav, params, force) {

            '"><select id="dbSegment" aria-label="Segmen"><option>B2B</option><option>B2C</option></select><select id="dbProgram" aria-label="Program"><option value="">Semua program</option>' + segmentPrograms_().map(p=>'<option>'+esc(p)+'</option>').join('') + '</select><select id="dbRegion" aria-label="Region"><option value="">Semua region</option></select><select id="dbBatch" aria-label="Batch"><option value="">Semua batch</option></select><select id="dbStatus" aria-label="Status peserta"><option value="">Semua status</option>' +
            STATUSES.map((x) => "<option>" + x + "</option>").join("") +
            '</select><select id="dbTrack" aria-label="Jalur program"><option value="">Semua jalur</option><option value="TALENT">Talent</option><option value="STANDARDISASI">Standarisasi</option><option value="BOTH">Keduanya</option><option value="UNASSIGNED">Belum ditetapkan</option></select></div>' +
            (admin
              ? '<div id="bulkBar" class="bulk-bar" hidden><span id="selectionLabel" role="status">0 peserta dipilih</span><div class="actions"><select id="bulkPhase" aria-label="Phase tujuan">' +
                PHASES.map((x) => "<option>" + x + "</option>").join("") +
                "</select>" +
                button("Pindahkan phase", "bulk-phase", "", "small") +
                button("Batalkan pilihan", "clear-selection", "", "small") +
                "</div></div>"
              : "") +
            '<div id="listBody">' +
            loading() +
            "</div>",
        );
        $("dbProgram").value = listState.program;
        $("dbSegment").value=S.segment;
        $("dbSegment").addEventListener("change",()=>switchSegment_($("dbSegment").value,"database").catch(handleError));
        $("dbStatus").value = listState.status;
        $("dbTrack").value = listState.track;
        let debounce;
        $("dbSearch").addEventListener("input", () => {
          clearTimeout(debounce);
          debounce = setTimeout(() => {
            if(!alive(nav)) return;
            listState.search = $("dbSearch").value;
            listState.page = 1;
            S.selected.clear();selectionLabel();
            loadParticipantRows(nav, false).catch(handleError);
          }, 300);
        });
        [
          ["dbProgram", "program"],
          ["dbRegion", "region"],
          ["dbBatch", "batch"],
          ["dbStatus", "status"],
          ["dbTrack", "track"],
        ].forEach(([id, key]) =>
          $(id).addEventListener("change", () => {
            if(!alive(nav)) return;
            listState[key] = $(id).value;
            if (key === "program" || key === "region") {
              listState.batch = "";
              $("dbBatch").value = "";
            }
            listState.page = 1;
            S.selected.clear();selectionLabel();
            loadParticipantRows(nav, false).catch(handleError);
          }),
        );
        await loadParticipantRows(nav, force);
      }
      async function loadParticipantRows(nav, force) {
        const admin=S.dashboard.session.role === "ADMIN",
          owner=retainedViews.active,
          seq = owner ? (owner.listSequence=(owner.listSequence || 0)+1) : ++listSequence,
          body=$("listBody");
        // Keep the last rows visible, but prevent selecting an old filter's rows.
        body.inert=true;body.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
        try {
        const data = await viewResource_(
            "getParticipantPage",
            [{ ...listState, light: true }],
            30000,
            force,
          );
        if (!alive(nav) || seq !== (owner ? owner.listSequence : listSequence)) return;
        S.rows = data.rows;
        S.pageData = data;
        const current = $("dbRegion").value;
        $("dbRegion").innerHTML =
          '<option value="">Semua region</option>' +
          (data.regions || [])
            .map((x) => "<option>" + esc(x) + "</option>")
            .join("");
        $("dbRegion").value = current || listState.region;
        $("dbBatch").innerHTML = '<option value="">Semua batch</option>' +
          (data.batches || []).map((batch) => '<option value="' + esc(batch) + '">' + esc(batch) + '</option>').join('');
        $("dbBatch").value = listState.batch;
        if (!data.rows.length) {
          $("listBody").innerHTML = empty(
            "Peserta tidak ditemukan",
            "Coba kata kunci atau filter lain.",
          );
          selectionLabel();
          return;
        }
        $("listBody").innerHTML = table(
          [
            ...(admin ? ['<input type="checkbox" id="selectPage" aria-label="Pilih semua pada halaman ini">'] : []),
            "NIK",
            "Nama / Jabatan",
            "Program / Batch",
            "Jalur",
            "Region",
            "Phase",
            "Status",
            "",
          ],
          data.rows
            .map(
              (r) =>
                "<tr>" +
                (admin
                  ? '<td><input type="checkbox" data-select="' +
                    esc(r.enrollmentId) +
                    '" aria-label="Pilih ' +
                    esc(r.name) +
                    '" ' +
                    (S.selected.has(r.enrollmentId) ? "checked" : "") +
                    "></td>"
                  : "") +
                '<td class="mono">' + esc(r.nik) +
                '</td><td><span class="table-name">' +
                esc(r.name) +
                '</span><span class="muted">' +
                esc(r.jobTitle || "—") +
                "</span></td><td>" +
                esc(r.program) +
                '<span class="muted">' +
                esc(r.batch) +
                "</span></td><td>" +
                esc(({TALENT:"Talent",STANDARDISASI:"Standarisasi",BOTH:"Keduanya"})[r.programTrack] || r.programTrack || "Belum ditetapkan") +
                "</td><td>" + fmt(r.region) +
                "</td><td>" +
                badge(r.currentPhase) +
                "</td><td>" +
                badge(r.participantStatus) +
                '</td><td><div class="table-actions">' +
                button(
                  "Detail",
                  "detail",
                  'data-nik="' + esc(r.nik) + '"',
                  "small",
                ) +
                (admin
                  ? button(
                      "Edit",
                      "edit-participant",
                      'data-id="' + esc(r.enrollmentId) + '"',
                      "small",
                    )
                  : "") +
                "</div></td></tr>",
            )
            .join(""),
          pager(data),
        );
        if (admin) {
          $("selectPage").checked = data.rows.every((r) =>
            S.selected.has(r.enrollmentId),
          );
          $("selectPage").addEventListener("change", () => {
            data.rows.forEach((r) => {
              $("selectPage").checked
                ? S.selected.add(r.enrollmentId)
                : S.selected.delete(r.enrollmentId);
            });
            document
              .querySelectorAll("[data-select]")
              .forEach(
                (el) => (el.checked = S.selected.has(el.dataset.select)),
              );
            selectionLabel();
          });
          document.querySelectorAll("[data-select]").forEach((el) =>
            el.addEventListener("change", () => {
              el.checked
                ? S.selected.add(el.dataset.select)
                : S.selected.delete(el.dataset.select);
              selectionLabel();
            }),
          );
          selectionLabel();
        }
        } finally {
          if(alive(nav) && seq === (owner ? owner.listSequence : listSequence)) {
            body.inert=false;body.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");
          }
        }
      }
      function selectionLabel() {
        const label=$("selectionLabel"),bar=$("bulkBar"),all=$("selectPage");
        if(label) label.textContent=S.selected.size + " peserta dipilih";
        if(bar) bar.hidden=!S.selected.size;
        if(all) {
          const rows=S.rows || [],count=rows.filter(r=>S.selected.has(r.enrollmentId)).length;
          all.checked=rows.length>0 && count===rows.length;
          all.indeterminate=count>0 && count<rows.length;
        }
      }
      function participantEditor(row) {
        if(S.dashboard?.session?.role!=="ADMIN") return toast("Pengelolaan peserta khusus Admin.",true);
        const r = row || {},
          existing = !!row;
        modal(
          existing ? "Edit Peserta" : "Tambah Peserta",
          existing
            ? r.program + " · " + r.batch

            (existing ? field("Segmen","segment",r.segment || S.segment,"text","readonly") : select("Segmen","segment",["B2B","B2C"],S.segment)) +

              r.nik || "",
              "text",
              "required " + (existing ? "readonly" : ""),
            ) +
            field("Nama lengkap", "name", r.name || "", "text", "required") +
            field("Jabatan", "jobTitle", r.jobTitle || "", "text", "required") +
            field("Lokasi", "location", r.location || "", "text", "required") +
            field("Kota", "cityName", r.cityName || "", "text", "required") +
            field("Region", "region", r.region || "", "text", "required") +
            (existing
              ? field("Program", "program", r.program, "text", "readonly")
              : select("Program", "program", segmentPrograms_().slice().reverse(), "TSHDP")) +
            field(
              "Batch",
              "batch",
              r.batch || "",
              "text",
              "required " + (existing ? "readonly" : ""),
            ) +
            select(
              "Status peserta",
              "status",
              STATUSES,
              r.participantStatus || "ELIGIBLE",
            ) +
            select(
              "Phase aktif",
              "currentPhase",
              PHASES,
              r.currentPhase || "PHASE 1",
            ) +
            select(
              "Jalur program",
              "programTrack",
              [
                { value: "", label: "Belum ditetapkan" },
                { value: "STANDARDISASI", label: "Standarisasi" },
                { value: "TALENT", label: "Talent" },
                { value: "BOTH", label: "Keduanya" },
              ],
              r.programTrack || "",
            ) +
            field("NIK Superior", "superiorNik", r.superiorNik || "") +
            field("NIK CLP", "clpNik", r.clpNik || "") +
            "</div>" +
            formActions() +
            "</form>",
        );
        if(!existing) $("f_segment").addEventListener("change",()=>{
          $("f_program").innerHTML=segmentPrograms_($("f_segment").value).map(p=>'<option>'+esc(p)+'</option>').join('');
        });
        form("participantForm", async (data) => {
          await rpc("saveParticipantControl", S.token, {
            ...Object.fromEntries(data),
            recordVersion: r.recordVersion,
          });
          invalidate([
            "getParticipantPage",
            "getParticipantFullDetail",
            "getDashboard",
            "getUserAccountsPage",
          ]);
          closeModal();
          toast("Data peserta tersimpan.");
          if(data.get("segment")!==S.segment)return switchSegment_(data.get("segment"),"database");
          navigate(S.view, S.params, true);
        });
      }
      function resultModal(t, statusOnly = false) {
        modal(
          statusOnly ? "Status Peserta" : "Hasil Program",
          t.program + " · " + t.batch,
          '<form id="resultForm">' +
            select(
              statusOnly ? "Status peserta" : "Hasil program",
              "value",
              statusOnly ? STATUSES : RESULTS,
              statusOnly ? "ELIGIBLE" : "ON GOING",
            ) +
            formActions() +
            "</form>",
        );
        form("resultForm", async (data) => {
          const r = await rpc(
            statusOnly ? "updateParticipantStatus" : "updateParticipantResult",
            S.token,
            t,
            data.get("value"),
          );
          invalidate([
            "getDashboard",
            "getParticipantFullDetail",
            "getParticipantPage",
            "getCertificatesOverview",
          ]);
          closeModal();
          toast(r.message || "Perubahan tersimpan.");
          navigate(S.view, S.params, true);
        });
      }

      async function renderWorkspace(nav, params, force) {
        const mode = S.view === "project" ? "PROJECT" : "EVIDENCE";
        content(
          pageHead(
            mode === "PROJECT" ? "Project" : "Mentoring",
            mode === "PROJECT"
              ? "Unggah dokumen Proposal, Progress, dan Final sesuai program."
              : "Simpan bukti mentoring dan catatan pertemuan.",

            '<div id="workspaceBody">' +
            loading() +
            "</div>",
        );

        if (!e) {
          $("workspaceBody").innerHTML = empty("Program belum tersedia");
          return;
        }
        $("workspaceProgram").addEventListener("change", () => {
          S.enrollmentId = $("workspaceProgram").value;
          navigate(S.view);
        });
        const w = await viewResource_(
          "getParticipantWorkspace",
          [target(e)],
          30000,

        );
        if (!alive(nav)) return;
        S.workspace = w;
        let html = "";
        if (w.unassignedLegacy)
          html +=
            '<div class="notice amber">Ada dokumen lama yang belum dipetakan ke program ini. Hubungi Admin untuk memeriksa pemetaan.</div>';
        if (mode === "PROJECT") {
          const unlocked =

            w.mentoring.some((m) => !!(m.FileUrl || m.DriveFileId));
          if (!unlocked)
            html +=
              '<div class="notice">Upload project tersedia setelah peserta mencapai Phase 3 dan memiliki minimal satu bukti mentoring.</div>';
          html +=
            '<div class="grid three">' +
            ["PROPOSAL", "PROGRESS", "FINAL"]
              .map((ph) => {
                const list = w.submissions[ph] || [],

                return (
                  '<section class="card"><span class="program-tag">' +

                  '</span><h3 style="margin:16px 0 8px">' +
                  (latest ? "Versi " + latest.Version : "Belum diunggah") +
                  '</h3><p class="muted">' +
                  (latest
                    ? esc(latest.FileName)
                    : "Unggah PPT, PDF, atau gambar pendukung.") +
                  "</p>" +
                  (latest
                    ? '<div style="margin-bottom:17px">' +
                      link(latest.FileUrl, "Buka dokumen") +
                      '<span class="muted" style="display:block;font-size:12px">' +
                      date(latest.SubmittedAt) +
                      "</span></div>"
                    : "") +
                  button(
                    latest ? "Unggah versi baru" : "Unggah dokumen",
                    "upload-project",
                    'data-phase="' + ph + '" ' + (!unlocked ? "disabled" : ""),
                    "small primary",
                  ) +
                  (list.length > 1
                    ? '<details style="margin-top:18px"><summary>Riwayat ' +
                      list.length +
                      " versi</summary>" +
                      list
                        .map(
                          (x) =>
                            '<p style="margin:8px 0">' +
                            link(x.FileUrl, "Versi " + x.Version) +
                            " · " +
                            date(x.SubmittedAt) +
                            "</p>",
                        )
                        .join("") +
                      "</details>"
                    : "") +
                  "</section>"
                );
              })
              .join("") +
            '</div><div class="section-heading"><h2>Kelengkapan panelisasi</h2>' +
            badge(w.eligibility.eligible ? "Lengkap" : "Belum lengkap") +
            '</div><section class="card">' +
            (w.eligibility.missing.length
              ? w.eligibility.missing
                  .map((x) => "<p>" + esc(x) + "</p>")
                  .join("")
              : "Proposal, Progress, Final, dan bukti mentoring telah tersedia.") +
            "</section>";
        } else {
          html +=
            '<div class="actions" style="margin-bottom:18px">' +
            button(
              icon("upload") + " Unggah bukti mentoring",
              "upload-evidence",
              "",
              "primary",
            ) +
            "</div>" +
            (w.mentoring.length
              ? table(
                  ["Tanggal", "Mentor", "Dokumen", "Catatan"],
                  w.mentoring
                    .map(
                      (m) =>
                        "<tr><td>" +
                        date(m.MentoringDate) +
                        "</td><td>" +
                        esc(m.MentorRole) +
                        "</td><td>" +
                        link(m.FileUrl, m.FileName || "Buka dokumen") +
                        '</td><td class="wrap">' +
                        fmt(m.Feedback || m.Notes) +
                        "</td></tr>",
                    )
                    .join(""),
                )
              : empty(
                  "Belum ada bukti mentoring",
                  "Unggah bukti pertemuan pertama Anda.",
                ));
        }
        $("workspaceBody").innerHTML = html;
      }
      function operationId() {
        return typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID
          ? crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "")
          : "op_" + Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
      }
      function fileBase64(file) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const r = new FileReader();
          r.onload = () => resolve(r.result);
          r.onerror = () => reject(new Error("File tidak dapat dibaca."));
          r.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
      }
      function uploadModal(mode, phase) {
        const e = selectedProgram(),
          id = operationId();
        if (!e) return;
        const mentoring = mode === "EVIDENCE";
        modal(
          mentoring ? "Unggah Bukti Mentoring" : "Unggah " + phase,
          e.program + " · " + e.batch,
          '<form id="uploadForm">' +
            (mentoring
              ? '<div class="form-grid">' +
                select(
                  "Mentor",
                  "mentorRole",
                  ["ASH", "TSH", "LOB", "CLP"],
                  "CLP",
                ) +
                field(
                  "Tanggal mentoring",
                  "mentoringDate",
                  new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", {
                    timeZone: "Asia/Jakarta",
                  }),
                  "date",
                  "required",
                ) +
                '</div><div class="field"><label for="uploadNotes">Catatan mentoring</label><textarea id="uploadNotes" name="notes" placeholder="Topik dan hasil diskusi"></textarea></div>'
              : "") +
            '<div class="field"><label for="uploadFile">Dokumen</label><input id="uploadFile" class="file-input" name="file" type="file" accept=".ppt,.pptx,.pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg" required><span class="field-help">PPT, PPTX, PDF, PNG, atau JPG. Maksimal 20 MB, mengikuti pengaturan Admin.</span></div>' +
            formActions("Unggah") +
            "</form>",
        );
        form("uploadForm", async (data, f) => {
          const file = f.querySelector("[type=file]").files[0];
          if (!file) throw new Error("Pilih file terlebih dahulu.");
          if (file.size > 20 * 1024 * 1024)
            throw new Error("File maksimal 20 MB.");
          const base64 = await fileBase64(file),
            payload = {
              ...target(e),
              fileName: file.name,
              mimeType:
                file.type ||
                (/\.pptx$/i.test(file.name)
                  ? "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation"
                  : /\.ppt$/i.test(file.name)
                    ? "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint"
                    : "application/octet-stream"),
              base64,
              operationId: id,
              phase: phase || "",
              mentorRole: data.get("mentorRole"),
              mentoringDate: data.get("mentoringDate"),
              notes: data.get("notes"),
            };
          await rpc(
            mentoring ? "uploadMentoringEvidence" : "uploadProject",
            S.token,
            payload,
          );
          invalidate([
            "getParticipantWorkspace",
            "getParticipantPage",
            "getDashboard",
          ]);
          closeModal();
          toast("Dokumen berhasil diunggah.");
          navigate(S.view, S.params, true);
        });
      }
      async function renderMyCertificate(nav, params, force) {
        if (force) await loadDashboard(true);

        content(

            dashboardNotice_() + (S.dashboard.programDashboards || [])
              .map(
                (e) =>
                  '<section class="card ' +
                  (e.certificateUrl ? "certificate-ready" : "") +
                  '"><div class="program-header"><div><span class="program-tag">' +

                      ? "Sertifikat dari template akan otomatis tersedia setelah selesai diproses."
                      : "Sertifikat dari template tersedia setelah peserta memenuhi syarat dan file selesai diproses.") +

        startDashboardHydration_();

      function download(result) {
        const blob = new Blob([result.content], {
            type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8",
          }),
          url = URL.createObjectURL(blob),
          a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = result.filename || "LDP.csv";
        a.click();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 3000);
      }
      function importModal(kind) {
        const cert = kind === "CERT",
          qleap = kind === "QLEAP",
          title = cert
            ? "Import Sertifikat"
            : qleap
              ? "Import Hasil QLEAP"
              : "Import Peserta";
        modal(
          title,
          cert
            ? "Peserta harus sudah berstatus lulus pada program dan batch yang sesuai."
            : qleap
              ? "Gunakan file export QLEAP dengan header exam yang lengkap."
              : "Isi NIK, Nama, Job Title, Region, Program, Batch, dan Segmen. Maksimal 250 peserta per file.",
          '<form id="importForm">' +
            (!cert && !qleap
              ? '<p class="muted">Program mengikuti segmen aktif. Isi kolom Segmen B2B atau B2C; template lama tanpa Segmen dibaca sebagai B2B. Peserta baru dimulai dari Phase 1 dengan status Eligible dan otomatis mendapat akun login NIK. Impor ulang mempertahankan fase, status, dan nilai yang sudah ada.</p>'
              : "") +
            '<div class="field"><label for="importFile">File CSV atau Excel</label><input id="importFile" class="file-input" name="file" type="file" accept=".csv,.xlsx,.xls" required><span class="field-help">Gunakan header sesuai template. File maksimal 20 MB.</span></div>' +
            (!qleap
              ? button(
                  "Download template",
                  cert ? "certificate-template" : "participant-template",
                )
              : "") +
            formActions("Import file") +
            "</form>",
        );
        form("importForm", async (data, f) => {
          const file = f.querySelector("[type=file]").files[0];
          if (!file) throw new Error("Pilih file terlebih dahulu.");
          if (file.size > 20 * 1024 * 1024)
            throw new Error("File maksimal 20 MB.");
          const res = await rpc(
            cert
              ? "uploadCertificateImport"
              : qleap
                ? "uploadQleapPostTest"
                : "uploadParticipants",
            S.token,
            {
              // Send only serialized file data. FormData also contains a native File.
              fileName: file.name,
              mimeType: file.type,
              base64: await fileBase64(file),
            },
          );
          invalidate([
            "getParticipantPage",
            "getDashboard",
            "getUserAccountsPage",
            "getQleapPostTestRecap",
            "getMyQleapPostTest",
          ]);
          if (!cert && !qleap) {
            invalidate(["getRawImportOptions", "getParticipantFullDetail", "getParticipantWorkspace"]);
            rawImportState.options = null; rawImportState.optionsAt = 0;
            moduleLinkState.options = null; moduleLinkState.optionsAt = 0;
          }
          closeModal();
          toast(res.message || "Import selesai.");
          if (cert) {
            S.certImportBatch = res.batchId;
            showCertificateImport(res.batchId);
          } else navigate(S.view, S.params, true);
        });
      }
      let userPage = { page: 1, pageSize: 30, search: "" };

      let certPage = { page: 1, pageSize: 30, search: "" };
      const certificateRefresh_={timer:null,sequence:0};
      function stopCertificateRefresh_() {
        clearTimeout(certificateRefresh_.timer);
        certificateRefresh_.timer=null;certificateRefresh_.sequence++;
      }
      function scheduleCertificateRefresh_(nav,data,delay=15000) {
        stopCertificateRefresh_();
        if(S.view!=="certificates" || !alive(nav) ||
          !(data.rows || []).some(r=>["QUEUED","PROCESSING"].includes(r.jobStatus))) return;
        const ticket=certificateRefresh_.sequence,epoch=S.epoch,generation=S.readGeneration,query={...certPage},
          current=()=>ticket===certificateRefresh_.sequence && epoch===S.epoch && generation===S.readGeneration &&
            S.view==="certificates" && alive(nav) && JSON.stringify(query)===JSON.stringify(certPage),
          editing=()=>$('dialog').open || document.hidden ||
            (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id==="certSearch");
        certificateRefresh_.timer=setTimeout(async()=>{
          certificateRefresh_.timer=null;
          if(!current()) return;
          if(editing()) {scheduleCertificateRefresh_(nav,data,delay);return;}
          try {
            // Low-priority read only: never run or replay a certificate write here.
            const key=epoch+'|'+generation+'|getCertificatesOverview|'+JSON.stringify([S.token,query]);
            S.backgroundReadKeys.add(key);
            const request=resource('getCertificatesOverview',[query],30000,true,{freshSource:false,retainedBackground:true});
            S.backgroundReadKeys.delete(key);
            const latest=await request;
            if(!current()) return;
            if((JSON.stringify(latest.rows)!==JSON.stringify(data.rows) || (data.total!==undefined && latest.total!==data.total)) && !editing()) {
              await renderCurrentView_(nav,S.params,false);
            } else scheduleCertificateRefresh_(nav,editing()?data:latest,15000);
          } catch(error) {
            if(!current() || error.stale) return;
            if(/AUTH_/.test(String(error.message))) handleError(error);
            else scheduleCertificateRefresh_(nav,data,30000);
          }
        },delay);
      }

      const moduleLinkState = {epoch:-1, options:null, program:"TSHDP", phase:"PHASE 1", drafts:{}};
      async function renderQleapModules(nav, params = {}, force = false) {
        if (moduleLinkState.epoch !== S.epoch) Object.assign(moduleLinkState,{epoch:S.epoch,options:null,drafts:{}});
        const useLocalOptions = !force && moduleLinkState.options && Date.now() - (moduleLinkState.optionsAt || 0) < 120000;
        const options = useLocalOptions ? moduleLinkState.options : await resource("getRawImportOptions", [], 120000, force);
        if (!useLocalOptions) moduleLinkState.optionsAt = Date.now();
        if (!alive(nav)) return;
        moduleLinkState.options = options;
        if (options.programs[params.program]) moduleLinkState.program = params.program;
        if (["PHASE 1","PHASE 2","PHASE 3"].includes(params.phase)) moduleLinkState.phase = params.phase;
        content(pageHead("Modul QLEAP", "Atur link sekali per kompetensi. Peserta yang remedial mendapat link pada detail nilainya.") +
          '<section class="card"><div class="grid">' + select("Program","moduleProgram",segmentPrograms_(),moduleLinkState.program) + select("Phase","modulePhase",["PHASE 1","PHASE 2","PHASE 3"],moduleLinkState.phase) +
          '</div><p id="modulePhaseHint" class="muted"></p><form id="moduleLinksForm"><div id="moduleLinksRows"></div>' + formActions("Simpan link modul") + '</form></section>');
        function draw() {
          const p = $("f_moduleProgram").value, ph = $("f_modulePhase").value, key = p + "|" + ph;
          moduleLinkState.program = p; moduleLinkState.phase = ph;
          syncRetainedFormScope_('qleapmodules',{program:p,phase:ph});
          const mods = options.programs[p].phases[ph], draft = moduleLinkState.drafts[key] || {};
          $("modulePhaseHint").textContent = ph === "PHASE 3" ? "Soft Competency memakai satu skor total post-test. Link QLEAP dipakai untuk remedial tahap ini." : p === "TSHDP" && ph === "PHASE 1" ? "Studi kasus TSHDP memakai bobot 20–15–15–15–20–15. Remedial tetap dinilai per kompetensi." : "Nama kompetensi ditampilkan tanpa awalan In Class Training Score.";
          $("moduleLinksRows").innerHTML = '<div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Kompetensi</th><th>Link QLEAP</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + mods.map((m,i) => '<tr><td>' + esc(m.module === "POST-TEST" ? "Soft Competency" : m.module) + (m.weight == null ? '' : '<small class="muted" style="display:block">Bobot ' + Math.round(m.weight*100) + '%</small>') + '</td><td><input type="url" aria-label="Link QLEAP ' + esc(m.module) + '" name="url_' + i + '" value="' + esc(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(draft,m.module) ? draft[m.module] : m.url || '') + '" placeholder="https://…"></td></tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
          document.querySelectorAll('#moduleLinksRows input').forEach((input,i) => input.addEventListener('input',()=> { (moduleLinkState.drafts[key] || (moduleLinkState.drafts[key]={}))[mods[i].module]=input.value; }));
        }
        $("f_moduleProgram").addEventListener("change",draw); $("f_modulePhase").addEventListener("change",draw); draw();
        form("moduleLinksForm", async (data) => {
          const program = moduleLinkState.program, phase = moduleLinkState.phase, mods = options.programs[program].phases[phase];
          const links = mods.map((m,i)=>({module:m.module,url:data.get("url_"+i) || ""}));
          await rpc("saveAssessmentQleapLinks",S.token,{program,phase,links});
          links.forEach((x,i)=>mods[i].url=x.url); delete moduleLinkState.drafts[program+"|"+phase];
          rawImportState.options = null;
          invalidate(["getRawImportOptions","getQleapMappings","getParticipantAssessmentDetail","getDashboard"]);
          toast("Link modul tersimpan. Peserta remedial dapat membukanya dari detail nilai.");
        });
      }

      async function assignLegacy(row) {
        const serial = modal(
          "Petakan Dokumen",
          row.nik + " · " + row.name,
          loading(),
        );
        try {
          const d = await resource(
            "getParticipantFullDetail",
            [row.nik],
            30000,
          );
          if (serial !== S.modal) return;
          $("modalContent").innerHTML =
            '<div class="modal-header"><div><h2>Petakan Dokumen</h2><p>' +
            esc(row.name) +
            '</p></div><button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" aria-label="Tutup">×</button></div><form id="legacyForm">' +
            select(
              "Program dan batch tujuan",
              "enrollmentId",
              d.enrollments.map((e) => ({
                value: e.enrollmentId,
                label: e.program + " · " + e.batch,
              })),
              d.enrollments[0] && d.enrollments[0].enrollmentId,
            ) +
            formActions("Simpan pemetaan") +
            "</form>";
          form("legacyForm", async (data) => {
            await rpc("assignLegacyRecord", S.token, {
              kind: row.kind,
              id: row.id,
              nik: row.nik,
              enrollmentId: data.get("enrollmentId"),
            });
            invalidate([
              "getMigrationIssues",
              "getParticipantWorkspace",
              "getParticipantFullDetail",
              "getCertificatesOverview",
              "getDashboard",
            ]);
            closeModal();
            toast("Pemetaan tersimpan.");
            navigate("legacy", {}, true);
          });
        } catch (e) {
          if (serial === S.modal) {
            closeModal();
            handleError(e);
          }
        }
      }

      const legacyMigrationState = {epoch:-1,preview:null,job:null,running:false};
      async function legacyMigrationModal() {
        const serial=modal('Tarik Data Lama',S.segment+' · '+segmentPrograms_().join(' dan '),loading()),epoch=S.epoch;
        try{
          const options=await resource('getLegacyMigrationOptions',[],120000);
          if(serial!==S.modal||epoch!==S.epoch)return;
          if(legacyMigrationState.epoch!==epoch)Object.assign(legacyMigrationState,{epoch,preview:null,job:null,running:false});
          $('modalContent').innerHTML='<div class="modal-header"><div><h2>Tarik Data Lama</h2><p>Ambil identitas peserta, lalu rekap nilai dari file mentah tiap tahap.</p></div><button type="button" class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" aria-label="Tutup">×</button></div>'+ '<p>Database lama dipakai untuk identitas dan batch. Nilai phase, final score, serta kelulusan dihitung dari sumber tahap; total database lama tidak dipakai.</p><form id="legacySourceForm">'+options.sources.map((x,i)=>'<label style="display:block;margin:12px 0"><input type="checkbox" id="legacyUse_'+i+'" checked> '+esc(x.program)+'</label>'+field('Link identitas peserta '+x.program,'legacyUrl_'+i,x.url,'url','required')).join('')+'<div class="actions"><button type="submit" class="btn primary">Analisis data lama</button>'+button('Riwayat migrasi','legacy-history')+'</div></form><div id="legacyMigrationPreview" style="margin-top:20px"></div><div id="legacyMigrationHistory"></div>';
          options.sources.forEach((x,i)=>$('legacyUse_'+i).addEventListener('change',()=>{$('f_legacyUrl_'+i).required=$('legacyUse_'+i).checked;}));
          form('legacySourceForm',async()=>{
            if(legacyMigrationState.running)throw new Error('Tunggu penyimpanan selesai.');
            const sources=options.sources.map((x,i)=>({program:x.program,url:$('f_legacyUrl_'+i).value,selected:$('legacyUse_'+i).checked})).filter(x=>x.selected).map(({program,url})=>({program,url}));if(!sources.length)throw new Error('Pilih minimal satu program.');
            $('legacyMigrationPreview').innerHTML=loading();
            try{const p=await rpc('prepareLegacyMigration',S.token,{sources,requestId:operationId()});if(serial!==S.modal||epoch!==S.epoch)return;
            legacyMigrationState.preview=p;legacyMigrationState.job=null;drawLegacyMigration();}catch(error){if(serial===S.modal&&epoch===S.epoch)$('legacyMigrationPreview').innerHTML='<div class="notice amber">'+esc(error.message)+'</div>';throw error;}
          });drawLegacyMigration();
        }catch(e){if(serial===S.modal){closeModal();handleError(e);}}
      }
      function drawLegacyMigration(){
        const box=$('legacyMigrationPreview');if(!box)return;const p=legacyMigrationState.preview,j=legacyMigrationState.job;if(!p)return;
        let html='<div class="notice">'+p.summary.sourceRows+' baris sumber · '+p.totalItems+' peserta siap disimpan · '+p.summary.errorCount+' perlu dicek · '+p.summary.duplicateRows+' duplikat identik digabung. '+(p.summary.selectedSource||0)+' pilihan sumber lama; '+(p.summary.keptCurrent||0)+' pilihan pertahankan aplikasi.</div>';
        if(j)html+='<p role="status"><strong>'+esc(j.status)+'</strong> · '+j.written+' tersimpan · '+j.skipped+' sudah ada · '+j.failed+' gagal. '+j.nextIndex+'/'+j.totalItems+' peserta.</p>'+((j.outcomes||[]).some(x=>x.status==='FAILED')?'<details open><summary>Gagal saat menyimpan</summary>'+(j.outcomes||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='FAILED').map(x=>'<p>'+esc(x.nik)+' · '+esc(x.message)+'</p>').join('')+'</details>':'');
        html+='<details><summary>Lihat daftar '+p.rows.length+' peserta</summary>'+table(['Peserta / Program','Batch','Sumber nilai','Hasil'],p.rows.map(r=>'<tr><td><strong>'+esc(r.data.Name)+'</strong><small style="display:block">'+esc(r.data.NIK)+' · '+esc(r.data.Program)+'</small></td><td>'+esc(r.data.Batch)+'</td><td>File mentah tiap tahap</td><td>'+esc(r.status)+'</td></tr>').join(''))+'</details>';
        const needs=p.rows.filter(r=>r.resolvable||r.status==='PERLU DICEK');
        if(needs.some(r=>r.resolvable&&r.status==='PERLU DICEK')&&!j)html+='<div class="actions">'+button('Pertahankan aplikasi untuk semua konflik','legacy-keep-all',legacyMigrationState.running?'disabled':'')+button('Pilih sumber lama untuk semua konflik','legacy-source-all',legacyMigrationState.running?'disabled':'')+'</div>';
        if(needs.length||p.errors.length)html+='<details open><summary>Periksa perbedaan data</summary>'+needs.map(r=>'<section class="notice amber"><strong>'+esc(r.data.Name)+' · '+esc(r.data.Program)+' · '+esc(r.data.Batch)+'</strong><p>'+esc(r.status)+'</p>'+ (r.resolvable?table(['Kolom','Di aplikasi','Di sumber'],r.conflicts.map(c=>'<tr><td>'+esc(c.field)+'</td><td>'+esc(c.current)+'</td><td>'+esc(c.source)+'</td></tr>').join(''))+button('Pertahankan data aplikasi dan lengkapi yang kosong','legacy-keep','data-key="'+esc(r.key)+'"'+(legacyMigrationState.running||j?' disabled':''),'small')+button('Pilih data sumber lama','legacy-source','data-key="'+esc(r.key)+'"'+(legacyMigrationState.running||j?' disabled':''),'small'): '<p>'+esc(r.conflicts.join(' '))+'</p>')+'</section>').join('')+p.errors.filter(e=>!e.resolvable).map(e=>'<p class="notice amber">'+esc(e.program)+' · baris '+e.rowNo+' · '+esc(e.message)+'</p>').join('')+'</details>';
        if(!j)html+='<p class="muted">Hanya baris siap yang disimpan. Baris Perlu Dicek tetap tercatat pada preview ini. Migrasi tidak mengubah file sumber.</p>'+button('Simpan '+p.totalItems+' peserta siap','legacy-save',!p.totalItems||legacyMigrationState.running?'disabled':'','primary');
        else if(j.status==='READY')html+=button('Lanjutkan penyimpanan','legacy-save',legacyMigrationState.running?'disabled':'','primary');
        if(j&&['COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS'].includes(j.status))html+='<div class="actions">'+button('Lanjutkan ke sumber nilai','legacy-grades','','primary')+'</div>';
        box.innerHTML=html;
      }
      async function keepLegacyCurrent(el,mode="KEEP_CURRENT",all=false){
        if(legacyMigrationState.running||legacyMigrationState.job)return;const p=legacyMigrationState.preview,epoch=S.epoch;
        const next=await rpc('reviewLegacyMigration',S.token,p.uploadId,p.previewVersion,all?Object.fromEntries(p.rows.filter(r=>r.status==='PERLU DICEK'&&r.resolvable).map(r=>[r.key,mode])):{[el.dataset.key]:mode});if(epoch!==S.epoch||legacyMigrationState.preview!==p)return;legacyMigrationState.preview=next;drawLegacyMigration();
      }
      async function saveLegacyMigration(){
        if(legacyMigrationState.running)return;const epoch=S.epoch;legacyMigrationState.running=true;drawLegacyMigration();
        try{let j=legacyMigrationState.job||{uploadId:legacyMigrationState.preview.uploadId,previewVersion:legacyMigrationState.preview.previewVersion,nextIndex:0};
          do{j=await rpc('commitRawImport',S.token,j.uploadId,j.previewVersion,j.nextIndex);if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;legacyMigrationState.job=j;invalidate(['getDashboard','getParticipantPage','getParticipantFullDetail','getParticipantAssessmentDetail','getRawImportOptions','getLegacyMigrationHistory','getCertificatesOverview']);drawLegacyMigration();}while(j.status==='READY');
          toast(j.status==='COMPLETE'?'Migrasi selesai. Peserta lama sudah masuk.':'Periksa hasil dan daftar Perlu Dicek.',j.status!=='COMPLETE');
        }catch(e){toast('Status penyimpanan perlu diperiksa melalui Riwayat migrasi. '+e.message,true);}
        finally{if(epoch===S.epoch){legacyMigrationState.running=false;drawLegacyMigration();}}
      }
      async function legacyMigrationHistory(){
        const serial=S.modal,rows=await resource('getLegacyMigrationHistory',[],30000,true);if(serial!==S.modal||!$('legacyMigrationHistory'))return;
        $('legacyMigrationHistory').innerHTML='<h3>Riwayat migrasi</h3>'+table(['Waktu','Status','Tersimpan',''],rows.map(j=>'<tr><td>'+date(j.createdAt)+'</td><td>'+esc(j.status)+'</td><td>'+j.written+'</td><td>'+button('Lihat hasil','legacy-open','data-id="'+esc(j.uploadId)+'"','small')+'</td></tr>').join(''));
      }
      async function openLegacyMigration(el){if(legacyMigrationState.running)return toast('Tunggu penyimpanan selesai.',true);const epoch=S.epoch,id=el.dataset.id,p=await rpc('getLegacyMigrationPreview',S.token,id),j=await rpc('getRawImportStatus',S.token,id);if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;legacyMigrationState.preview=p;legacyMigrationState.job=j.status==='PREVIEW'?null:j;drawLegacyMigration();}
      function historicalCard_(e){
        if(!e.historicalInfo)return '';
        return '<section class="notice" style="margin-top:16px"><strong>Rekap otomatis</strong><p>Nilai mengikuti rincian tahap. Jika data tahap belum tersedia untuk batch lama, total diambil dari Participant. Rincian kompetensi hanya ditampilkan jika tersedia.</p></section>';
      }
