Jika belum lengkap, hasilnya menjadi On Going. Snapshot lama tetap disimpan.</p><form id="historicalReleaseForm">'+formActions('Hitung ulang enrollment ini')+'</form>');form('historicalReleaseForm',async()=>{const r=await rpc('releaseHistoricalGrading',S.token,{...t,recordVersion:v});invalidate(['getDashboard','getParticipantFullDetail','getParticipantPage','getParticipantAssessmentDetail']);closeModal();toast(r.message);if(S.view==='detail')navigate('detail',S.params,true);});}

      function rawSourceForm_(){
        const program=rawImportState.selected?.program||'TSHDP';
        return '<details style="margin-top:20px"><summary>Impor arsip dari link lama</summary><p>Untuk memasukkan arsip dari sumber terhubung. Untuk memperbarui dashboard dari spreadsheet aplikasi yang sudah terisi, gunakan Sinkron Nilai pada Database Peserta.</p>'+button('Impor arsip dari link','legacy-sync','data-program="'+esc(program)+'"')+'</details>';
      }
      const dashboardSheetSync_={running:false,epoch:-1,modal:0,progress:null};
      function drawDashboardSheetSync_(){
        const st=dashboardSheetSync_;if(st.epoch!==S.epoch||st.modal!==S.modal||!st.progress)return;
        const p=st.progress;
        $('dashboardSheetSyncProgress').innerHTML='<p role="status"><strong>'+(st.running?'Memperbarui dashboard…':p.error?'Sinkron terhenti':'Sinkron selesai')+'</strong> · '+p.cursor+'/'+p.total+' peserta</p><progress max="'+Math.max(1,p.total)+'" value="'+p.cursor+'" style="width:100%" aria-label="Sinkron nilai"></progress><p>'+p.written+' diperbarui · '+p.skipped+' sudah sesuai · '+p.failed+' perlu dicek.</p><p class="muted">Nilai dan rumus Participants tetap utuh. Dashboard membaca rincian tiap tahap, lalu memakai nilai Participants jika rincian belum tersedia.</p>'+(p.error?'<p class="notice amber">'+esc(p.error)+' Klik Sinkron Nilai kembali untuk membaca ulang sumber.</p>':'')+(p.errors.length?'<details open><summary>Data perlu dicek</summary>'+p.errors.map(x=>'<p>'+esc(x)+'</p>').join('')+'</details>':'');
      }
      async function syncDashboardFromSheets_(){
        const epoch=S.epoch;
        if(S.dashboard?.session?.role!=='ADMIN')return toast('Sinkron nilai khusus Admin.',true);
        if(dashboardSheetSync_.running&&dashboardSheetSync_.epoch===epoch)return toast('Sinkron nilai masih berjalan.');
        if(oneClickSync_.running&&oneClickSync_.epoch===epoch||rawImportState.running&&rawImportState.epoch===epoch)return toast('Tunggu proses import selesai.',true);
        dashboardSheetSync_.running=true;dashboardSheetSync_.epoch=epoch;
        if(rawImportState.epoch!==epoch)Object.assign(rawImportState,{epoch,options:null,preview:null,job:null,selected:null,running:false});
        rawImportState.running=true;dashboardSheetSync_.progress=null;
        dashboardSheetSync_.modal=modal('Sinkron Nilai','Sheet database → Dashboard','<div id="dashboardSheetSyncProgress" aria-live="polite">'+loading()+'</div>');
        const token=S.token,scope={program:listState.program||'',region:listState.region||'',batch:listState.batch||'',track:listState.track||'',ids:[...S.selected]};
        try{
          const plan=await rpc('getDashboardScoreSyncPlan',token,scope);if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;
          const p=dashboardSheetSync_.progress={cursor:0,total:plan.total,written:0,skipped:0,failed:0,errors:[]};drawDashboardSheetSync_();
          while(p.cursor<plan.total){
            const out=await rpc('syncDashboardScores',token,{...scope,key:plan.key,cursor:p.cursor,requestId:operationId()});if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;
            if(out.next<=p.cursor)throw new Error('Posisi sinkron tidak bergerak. Klik Sinkron Nilai lagi.');
            p.cursor=out.next;p.written+=out.written;p.skipped+=out.skipped;p.failed+=out.failed;p.errors.push(...(out.outcomes||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='FAILED').slice(0,20).map(x=>x.nik+' · '+x.message));
            invalidate(['getDashboard','getParticipantPage','getParticipantFullDetail','getParticipantAssessmentDetail','getProgramProgress','getBehaviorDetail','getPanelDetail']);drawDashboardSheetSync_();
          }
          toast(plan.total?(p.failed?'Dashboard diperbarui. Beberapa data perlu dicek.':'Nilai dashboard sudah sesuai sheet.'):'Tidak ada peserta sesuai filter.',!!p.failed);
          if(S.view==='database')await loadParticipantRows(S.nav,true);
        }catch(error){if(epoch===S.epoch){if(!dashboardSheetSync_.progress)dashboardSheetSync_.progress={cursor:0,total:0,written:0,skipped:0,failed:0,errors:[]};dashboardSheetSync_.progress.error=error.message;handleError(error);}}
        finally{if(epoch===S.epoch){dashboardSheetSync_.running=false;rawImportState.running=false;drawDashboardSheetSync_();}}
      }

      const oneClickSync_={running:false,epoch:-1,run:null,modal:0,key:''};
      function persistOneClick_(){
        try{localStorage.setItem(oneClickSync_.key,JSON.stringify(oneClickSync_.run));}catch(error){}
      }
      function drawOneClick_(){
        if(oneClickSync_.epoch!==S.epoch||oneClickSync_.modal!==S.modal||!$('oneClickSyncProgress'))return;
        const run=oneClickSync_.run;if(!run)return;
        const done=run.steps.filter(x=>['COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS','SKIPPED','FAILED','NEEDS_REVIEW'].includes(x.status)).length;
        $('oneClickSyncProgress').innerHTML='<p role="status"><strong>'+esc(run.status==='RUNNING'?'Sinkron sedang berjalan':run.status==='COMPLETE'?'Sinkron selesai':run.status==='PAUSED'?'Sinkron terjeda':'Sinkron selesai dengan catatan')+'</strong> · '+done+'/'+run.steps.length+' tahap</p><progress max="'+run.steps.length+'" value="'+done+'" style="width:100%" aria-label="Progres sinkron"></progress>'+table(['Tahap','Status','Hasil'],run.steps.map(x=>'<tr><td>'+esc(x.label)+'</td><td>'+esc(({PENDING:'Menunggu',PREPARING:'Membaca sumber',PREVIEW:'Mengolah',READY:'Menyimpan',PROCESSING:'Menyimpan',COMPLETE:'Selesai',COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS:'Selesai dengan catatan',SKIPPED:'Dilewati',FAILED:'Perlu dicek',NEEDS_REVIEW:'Perlu dicek'})[x.status]||x.status)+'</td><td>'+(x.written||0)+' tersimpan'+(x.skipped?' · '+x.skipped+' sudah ada':'')+(x.issues?' · '+x.issues+' catatan':'')+(x.error?'<small style="display:block">'+esc(x.error)+'</small>':'')+((x.notes||[]).length?'<details><summary>Lihat catatan</summary>'+x.notes.map(n=>'<p>'+esc(n)+'</p>').join('')+'</details>':'')+'</td></tr>').join(''))+(run.status==='RUNNING'?'<p class="muted">Proses berjalan bertahap. Tetap buka aplikasi sampai selesai.</p>':'<p>Nilai peserta sudah mengikuti tahap yang berhasil disinkronkan. Komponen yang belum lengkap tetap On Going.</p>');
      }
      function showOneClick_(){
        oneClickSync_.modal=modal('Sinkron Data Lama','Otomatis dari link tersimpan','<div id="oneClickSyncProgress" aria-live="polite">'+loading()+'</div>');drawOneClick_();
      }
      function oneClickAlive_(epoch){if(epoch!==S.epoch||!S.token)throw staleError();}
      function oneClickNotes_(p){return (p.errors||[]).slice(0,8).map(x=>x.message||x.issue||String(x));}
      async function oneClickWait_(step,token,epoch){
        const end=Date.now()+360000;
        while(['PREPARING','PROCESSING'].includes(step.status)){
          oneClickAlive_(epoch);if(Date.now()>end)throw new Error('Proses masih berjalan. Klik Sinkron Data Lama lagi untuk membaca status tersimpan.');
          await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,2000));oneClickAlive_(epoch);
          const j=await rpc('getLegacySyncRequest',token,step.requestId);oneClickAlive_(epoch);
          if(!j)throw new Error('Status proses belum dapat dikonfirmasi.');
          if(j.status==='PREPARING'&&j.leaseUntil&&j.leaseUntil<=Date.now())throw new Error('Pembacaan sumber terputus. Data tahap ini belum disimpan.');
          Object.assign(step,{uploadId:j.uploadId,status:j.status,previewVersion:j.previewVersion,nextIndex:j.nextIndex,written:j.written,skipped:j.skipped,failed:j.failed});persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();
          if(j.status==='PROCESSING'&&j.leaseUntil<=Date.now()){const checked=await rpc('getRawImportStatus',token,j.uploadId);oneClickAlive_(epoch);step.status=checked.status;}
        }
      }
      async function oneClickStep_(step,definition,token,epoch){
        let p=null,j=null;step.error='';
        if(step.uploadId||step.attempted){j=await rpc('getLegacySyncRequest',token,step.requestId);oneClickAlive_(epoch);}
        if(j){Object.assign(step,{uploadId:j.uploadId,status:j.status,previewVersion:j.previewVersion,nextIndex:j.nextIndex,written:j.written,skipped:j.skipped,failed:j.failed});await oneClickWait_(step,token,epoch);}
        else{
          step.status='PREPARING';step.attempted=true;persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();
          try{p=definition.kind==='ROSTER'?await rpc('prepareLegacyMigration',token,{sources:definition.sources,requestId:step.requestId}):await rpc('prepareRawImport',token,{kind:definition.kind,phase:definition.phase,program:definition.program,batch:'AUTO',aggregation:definition.kind==='PANEL'?'ALL_MEAN':'LATEST',sourceUrl:definition.sourceUrl,requestId:step.requestId});}
          catch(error){
            oneClickAlive_(epoch);j=await rpc('getLegacySyncRequest',token,step.requestId);oneClickAlive_(epoch);
            if(!j)throw error;Object.assign(step,{uploadId:j.uploadId,status:j.status,previewVersion:j.previewVersion,nextIndex:j.nextIndex});await oneClickWait_(step,token,epoch);if(!['PREVIEW','READY','COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS'].includes(step.status))throw error;
          }
          oneClickAlive_(epoch);
          if(p)Object.assign(step,{uploadId:p.uploadId,status:p.status||'PREVIEW',previewVersion:p.previewVersion,nextIndex:0});
          persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();
        }
        if(['COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS'].includes(step.status))return;
        if(step.status==='PREVIEW'){
          if(!p)p=await rpc(definition.kind==='ROSTER'?'getLegacyMigrationPreview':'getRawImportPreview',token,step.uploadId);oneClickAlive_(epoch);
          if(definition.kind==='ROSTER'){
            const choices=Object.fromEntries((p.rows||[]).filter(x=>x.resolvable&&x.status==='PERLU DICEK').map(x=>[x.key,'KEEP_CURRENT']));
            if(Object.keys(choices).length){p=await rpc('reviewLegacyMigration',token,p.uploadId,p.previewVersion,choices);oneClickAlive_(epoch);}
          }
          step.issues=Number(p.summary?.errorCount||0);step.notes=oneClickNotes_(p);step.previewVersion=p.previewVersion;persistOneClick_();
          if(p.summary?.unmappedColumns)throw new Error('Format kolom belum dikenali. Tahap ini dilewati tanpa menebak kompetensi.');
          if(!p.totalItems){step.status='SKIPPED';step.error='Tidak ada baris baru yang dapat dicocokkan secara unik.';return;}
        }
        if(!['PREVIEW','READY'].includes(step.status))throw new Error('Status penyimpanan '+step.status+' perlu diperiksa.');
        while(['PREVIEW','READY'].includes(step.status)){
          oneClickAlive_(epoch);const cursor=Number(step.nextIndex||0);step.status='PROCESSING';persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();
          try{j=await rpc('commitRawImport',token,step.uploadId,step.previewVersion,cursor);}
          catch(error){
            oneClickAlive_(epoch);j=await rpc('getRawImportStatus',token,step.uploadId);oneClickAlive_(epoch);
            if(['PREVIEW','READY'].includes(j.status)&&Number(j.nextIndex||0)<=cursor)throw new Error('Penyimpanan belum terkonfirmasi. Klik Sinkron Data Lama untuk melanjutkan dari status tersimpan.');
          }
          oneClickAlive_(epoch);Object.assign(step,{status:j.status,previewVersion:j.previewVersion,nextIndex:j.nextIndex,written:j.written,skipped:j.skipped,failed:j.failed});
          if(j.failed){step.issues=Math.max(step.issues||0,j.failed);step.notes=(step.notes||[]).concat((j.outcomes||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='FAILED').slice(0,5).map(x=>x.message)).slice(0,10);}
          persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();await oneClickWait_(step,token,epoch);
          if(!['PREVIEW','READY','COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS'].includes(step.status))throw new Error(j.error||'Penyimpanan memerlukan pemeriksaan riwayat.');
        }
      }
      async function oneClickLegacySync(el){
        const epoch=S.epoch,program=typeof el==='string'?el:el?.dataset?.program||'';
        if(S.dashboard?.session?.role!=='ADMIN')return toast('Fitur ini khusus Admin.',true);
        if(oneClickSync_.running&&oneClickSync_.epoch===epoch){showOneClick_();return;}
        if(rawImportState.epoch!==epoch)Object.assign(rawImportState,{epoch,options:null,preview:null,job:null,selected:null,running:false});
        if(legacyMigrationState.epoch!==epoch)Object.assign(legacyMigrationState,{epoch,preview:null,job:null,running:false});
        if(rawImportState.running||legacyMigrationState.running)return toast('Tunggu proses import selesai.',true);
        const inMemoryRun=oneClickSync_.run;
        oneClickSync_.running=true;oneClickSync_.epoch=epoch;rawImportState.running=legacyMigrationState.running=true;oneClickSync_.run=null;showOneClick_();
        const token=S.token;
        try{
          const plan=await rpc('getLegacySyncPlan',token,program);oneClickAlive_(epoch);oneClickSync_.key='ldp_legacy_sync_'+S.segment+'_'+plan.owner+'_'+plan.program;
          let previous=null;try{previous=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(oneClickSync_.key)||'null');}catch(error){}
          if(!previous)previous=inMemoryRun;
          const reusable=previous&&previous.owner===plan.owner&&previous.planKey===plan.key&&['RUNNING','PAUSED'].includes(previous.status)&&previous.steps?.length===plan.steps.length&&previous.steps.every((x,i)=>x.id===plan.steps[i].id);
          oneClickSync_.run=reusable?previous:{owner:plan.owner,planKey:plan.key,startedAt:new Date().toISOString(),steps:plan.steps.map(x=>({id:x.id,label:x.label,status:'PENDING',requestId:operationId()}))};
          oneClickSync_.run.status='RUNNING';persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();
          for(let i=0;i<plan.steps.length;i++){
            oneClickAlive_(epoch);const step=oneClickSync_.run.steps[i];if(['COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS','SKIPPED','FAILED','NEEDS_REVIEW'].includes(step.status))continue;
            try{await oneClickStep_(step,plan.steps[i],token,epoch);}
            catch(error){oneClickAlive_(epoch);if(/AUTH_/.test(error.message))throw error;if(/belum terkonfirmasi|masih berjalan|belum dapat dikonfirmasi/.test(error.message)){oneClickSync_.run.status='PAUSED';step.error=error.message;persistOneClick_();throw error;}step.status=step.status==='NEEDS_REVIEW'?'NEEDS_REVIEW':'FAILED';step.error=error.message;}
            oneClickAlive_(epoch);persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();invalidate(['getDashboard','getParticipantPage','getParticipantFullDetail','getParticipantAssessmentDetail','getBehaviorDetail','getPanelDetail','getRawImportHistory','getCertificatesOverview']);
          }
          const problems=oneClickSync_.run.steps.some(x=>['FAILED','SKIPPED','NEEDS_REVIEW','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS'].includes(x.status)||x.issues);
          oneClickSync_.run.status=problems?'COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS':'COMPLETE';persistOneClick_();drawOneClick_();toast(problems?'Sinkron selesai. Beberapa data perlu dicek pada hasil.':'Sinkron selesai. Nilai dan status peserta sudah diperbarui.',problems);
          if(S.view==='database')await loadParticipantRows(S.nav,true);
        }catch(error){if(epoch===S.epoch){if(oneClickSync_.run&&oneClickSync_.run.status==='RUNNING'){oneClickSync_.run.status='PAUSED';persistOneClick_();}drawOneClick_();handleError(error);}}
        finally{if(epoch===S.epoch){oneClickSync_.running=false;rawImportState.running=legacyMigrationState.running=false;drawOneClick_();}}
      }

      const rawBundle_ = {files:[], epoch:-1, running:false,scopeKey:''};
      function rawBundleForm_() {
        return '<section class="card" style="margin-bottom:22px"><h2>Upload semua tahap</h2><p class="muted">Pilih program di atas, gunakan Batch Otomatis, lalu lampirkan file tahap yang sudah tersedia. Tidak perlu menyiapkan rumus atau memperbarui rekap peserta secara terpisah.</p><form id="rawBundleForm"><div class="grid three">'+
          [["p1","Phase 1"],["p2","Phase 2"],["p3","Phase 3 · Soft Competency"],["behavior","Behavior monitoring"],["panel","Panelisasi"]].map(([id,label])=>field(label,"bundle_"+id,"","file",'accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv"')).join('')+
          '</div><button type="submit" class="btn primary">Analisis semua file</button></form>'+rawSourceForm_()+'<div id="rawBundlePreview" aria-live="polite"></div></section>';
      }
      function drawRawBundle_() {
        const box=$("rawBundlePreview");if(!box)return;
        const files=rawBundle_.files;
        box.innerHTML=files.length?table(["Tahap / File","Pencocokan","Hasil"],files.map(x=>'<tr><td>'+esc(x.label)+'<small class="muted" style="display:block">'+esc(x.scope.program)+' · '+esc(x.scope.batch)+'</small><small class="muted" style="display:block">'+esc(x.name)+'</small></td><td>'+(x.preview?x.preview.summary.matchedParticipants+' peserta · '+x.preview.summary.errorCount+' baris bermasalah':'—')+'</td><td>'+esc(x.error|| (x.job?x.job.status:x.preview?'Siap ditinjau':'Sedang dianalisis…'))+(x.preview?rawIssues('Baris dilewati',x.preview.errors,x.preview.summary.errorCount)+rawIssues('Catatan',x.preview.warnings,x.preview.summary.warningCount):'')+'</td></tr>').join(''))+
          '<p class="muted">Rekap diproses per file, berurutan. Baris bermasalah dilewati dan tetap tercatat pada riwayat. File yang gagal tidak membatalkan file yang sudah tersimpan.</p>'+button('Simpan semua rekap valid','raw-bundle-save',rawBundle_.running||!files.some(x=>x.preview?.totalItems&&!x.job)||files.some(x=>x.preview?.summary.unmappedColumns)?'disabled':'','primary'):'';
      }
      function bindRawBundle_(nav,options) {
        if(rawBundle_.epoch!==S.epoch){rawBundle_.files=[];rawBundle_.epoch=S.epoch;rawBundle_.running=false;}
        drawRawBundle_();
        form('rawBundleForm',async()=>{
          if(rawImportState.running||rawBundle_.running)throw new Error('Tunggu proses upload selesai.');
          const scope=rawScope(),epoch=S.epoch,chosen=[['p1','Phase 1','SYLLABUS','PHASE 1'],['p2','Phase 2','SYLLABUS','PHASE 2'],['p3','Phase 3 · Soft Competency','SYLLABUS','PHASE 3'],['behavior','Behavior monitoring','BEHAVIOR',''],['panel','Panelisasi','PANEL','']].map(([id,label,kind,phase])=>({file:$('f_bundle_'+id).files[0],label,kind,phase})).filter(x=>x.file);
          if(!scope.batch)throw new Error('Pilih batch tujuan.');
          if(!chosen.length)throw new Error('Pilih minimal satu file tahap.');
          if(chosen.some(x=>x.file.size>options.maxFileMB*1024*1024))throw new Error('Setiap file maksimal '+options.maxFileMB+' MB.');
          rawImportState.running=rawBundle_.running=true;rawBundle_.files=[];rawBundle_.scopeKey=scope.program+'|'+scope.batch;
          try {
            for(const x of chosen){
              if(epoch!==S.epoch) return;
              const entry={label:x.label,name:x.file.name,scope:{kind:x.kind,phase:x.phase,program:scope.program,batch:scope.batch,aggregation:x.kind==='PANEL'?'ALL_MEAN':'LATEST'}};rawBundle_.files.push(entry);drawRawBundle_();
              try {entry.preview=await rpc('prepareRawImport',S.token,{...entry.scope,fileName:x.file.name,mimeType:x.file.type,base64:await fileBase64(x.file),requestId:operationId()});}
              catch(e){entry.error=e.message;}
              if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;drawRawBundle_();
            }
          }finally{if(epoch===S.epoch){rawImportState.running=rawBundle_.running=false;drawRawBundle_();}}
        });
      }
      async function saveRawBundle_() {
        if(rawImportState.running||rawBundle_.running)return;
        const epoch=S.epoch,nav=S.nav;rawImportState.running=rawBundle_.running=true;drawRawBundle_();
        try {
          for(const x of rawBundle_.files){
            if(!x.preview?.totalItems||x.job||x.preview.summary.unmappedColumns)continue;
            if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;
            try {
              // Prior file commits update the enrollment version. Rebuild each remaining
              // preview using the same source/mapping; manual overrides remain protected.
              const mappings=Object.fromEntries(x.preview.columns.map(c=>[c.id,c.module]));
              x.preview=await rpc('previewRawImport',S.token,x.preview.uploadId,mappings,x.preview.previewVersion);
              if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;
              let job={uploadId:x.preview.uploadId,previewVersion:x.preview.previewVersion,nextIndex:0};
              do {job=await rpc('commitRawImport',S.token,job.uploadId,job.previewVersion,job.nextIndex);if(epoch!==S.epoch)return;x.job=job;drawRawBundle_();invalidate(['getDashboard','getParticipantPage','getParticipantFullDetail','getParticipantAssessmentDetail','getParticipantWorkspace','getBehaviorDetail','getPanelDetail','getRawImportHistory','getCertificatesOverview']);} while(job.status==='READY');
              if(!['COMPLETE','COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS'].includes(job.status)){x.error='Periksa riwayat upload sebelum melanjutkan.';break;}
            } catch(e){x.error=e.message;break;}
          }
          if(epoch===S.epoch){toast(rawBundle_.files.some(x=>x.error)?'Sebagian file perlu diperiksa. Buka riwayat untuk melihat hasil.':'Proses rekap selesai. Periksa hasil tiap file.',rawBundle_.files.some(x=>x.error));if(alive(nav))await rawHistory(nav);}
        } finally {if(epoch===S.epoch){rawImportState.running=rawBundle_.running=false;drawRawBundle_();}}
      }

      const rawImportState = {
        epoch: -1,
        options: null,
        preview: null,
        job: null,
        running: false,
        selected: null,
      };
      function rawScope() {
        return {
          segment: S.segment,
          kind: $("f_rawKind").value,
          program: $("f_rawProgram").value,
          batch: $("f_rawBatch").value,
          phase: $("f_rawPhase").value,
          aggregation: $("f_rawAggregation").value,
        };
      }
      function rawScopeChanged(event) {
        if (rawImportState.running && event?.type === "change") {
          const previous = rawImportState.selected || {};
          for (const [field,key] of [["rawKind","kind"],["rawBatch","batch"],["rawPhase","phase"],["rawAggregation","aggregation"]]) if (previous[key]) $("f_"+field).value = previous[key];
          return toast("Tunggu penyimpanan upload selesai.", true);
        }
        if (event?.type === "change") { rawImportState.preview = null; rawImportState.job = null; drawRawPreview(); }
        const program = $("f_rawProgram").value,
          data = rawImportState.options.programs[program],
          old = $("f_rawBatch").value;
        syncRetainedFormScope_('rawimport',{program});
        $("f_rawBatch").innerHTML = data.batches
          .map((b) => '<option value="' + esc(b) + '">' + esc(b === "AUTO" ? "Otomatis · semua batch" : b) + "</option>")
          .join("");
        if (data.batches.includes(old)) $("f_rawBatch").value = old;
        const behavior = $("f_rawKind").value === "BEHAVIOR" || $("f_rawKind").value === "PANEL";
        if(event?.target?.id === "f_rawKind" && behavior) $("f_rawAggregation").value = $("f_rawKind").value === "PANEL" ? "ALL_MEAN" : "LATEST";
        $("rawPhaseField").hidden = behavior;
        $("rawAggregationField").hidden = !behavior;
        $("rawTemplateAction").hidden = behavior || $("f_rawPhase").value === "PHASE 3";
        rawImportState.selected = rawScope();
        const scopeKey=program+"|"+$("f_rawBatch").value;
        if(!rawBundle_.running && rawBundle_.scopeKey && rawBundle_.scopeKey!==scopeKey){rawBundle_.files=[];rawBundle_.scopeKey=scopeKey;drawRawBundle_();}
        const studyCase = program === "TSHDP" && $("f_rawPhase").value === "PHASE 1";
        $("rawHint").textContent = behavior
          ? "Form Responses 1 dibaca otomatis. Default upload semua tahap: behavior memakai observasi terbaru, panel rata-rata penilaian unik. Skala 1–5 dikonversi ×20 untuk nilai akhir. NIK panelis tidak dipakai sebagai NIK peserta."
          : studyCase ? "Studi kasus TSHDP: isi 6 nilai 0–100 pada template. Bobot 20%, 15%, 15%, 15%, 20%, 15%. Skor akhir muncul setelah seluruh kompetensi terisi; nilai 0 tetap dihitung."
          : "Export QLEAP dan Form Phase 3 dibaca otomatis. Nilai tertinggi per modul dipakai; koreksi Admin dipertahankan. Nilai kosong dilewati, angka 0 tetap dihitung.";
      }
      async function renderRawImport(nav, params, force) {
        if (rawImportState.epoch !== S.epoch) {
          Object.assign(rawImportState, {
            epoch: S.epoch,
            options: null,
            preview: null,
            job: null,
            running: false,
            selected: null,
          });
        }
        const useLocalOptions = !force && rawImportState.options && Date.now() - (rawImportState.optionsAt || 0) < 120000;
        const options = useLocalOptions ? rawImportState.options : await resource("getRawImportOptions", [], 120000, force);
        if (!useLocalOptions) rawImportState.optionsAt = Date.now();
        if (!alive(nav)) return;
        rawImportState.options = options;
        if (
          params.program &&
          options.programs[params.program] &&
          rawImportState.selected?.program !== params.program
        ) {
          rawImportState.selected = {
            kind: "SYLLABUS",
            program: params.program,
            phase: "PHASE 2",
            aggregation: "ALL_MEAN",
          };
          rawImportState.preview = null;
          rawImportState.job = null;
        }
        const selected = rawImportState.selected || {
            kind: "SYLLABUS",
            program: "TSHDP",
            phase: "PHASE 2",
            aggregation: "ALL_MEAN",
          },
          programs = Object.keys(options.programs);
        rawImportState.selected = selected;
        const panels = '<div class="raw-program-tabs" role="group" aria-label="Program tujuan upload">' +
          programs.map((program) => button(program, "raw-program", 'data-program="' + esc(program) + '" aria-pressed="' + (program === selected.program) + '" ' + (rawImportState.running ? 'disabled' : ''), program === selected.program ? 'primary' : '')).join('') + '</div>';
        content(
          pageHead(
            "Upload & Rekap · " + selected.program,
            "Unggah data mentah, periksa pencocokan, lalu simpan ke rekap peserta.",
          ) +
            panels + '<section class="card" style="margin-bottom:22px">'+select("Batch tujuan untuk semua upload","rawBatch",[],selected.batch,"required")+'</section>' + rawBundleForm_() +
            '<section class="card"><h2>Upload satu tahap / perbaikan pemetaan · ' +
            esc(selected.program) +
            '</h2><form id="rawImportForm"><div class="grid three">' +
            select(
              "Jenis data",
              "rawKind",
              [
                { value: "SYLLABUS", label: "Nilai Phase 1–3 / penilaian manual" },
                { value: "BEHAVIOR", label: "Behavior monitoring · 1–5" },
                { value: "PANEL", label: "Panelisasi · 8 rubrik" },
              ],
              selected.kind,
            ) +
            '<input id="f_rawProgram" type="hidden" value="' + esc(selected.program) + '">' +

            '<div id="rawPhaseField">' +
            select(
              "Phase tujuan",
              "rawPhase",
              ["PHASE 1", "PHASE 2", "PHASE 3"],
              selected.phase,
            ) +
            '</div><div id="rawAggregationField">' +
            select(
              "Cara rekap observasi / panel",
              "rawAggregation",
              [
                { value: "LATEST", label: "Observasi terbaru" },
                {
                  value: "RATER_LATEST",
                  label: "Rata-rata observasi terbaru tiap observer",
                },
                { value: "ALL_MEAN", label: "Rata-rata seluruh observasi" },
              ],
              selected.aggregation,
            ) +
            "</div>" +
            field(
              "File mentah · XLSX / XLS / CSV, maks. 5 MB",
              "rawFile",
              "",
              "file",
              'accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv" required',
            ) +
            '</div><p id="rawHint" class="muted"></p><div class="actions"><button type="submit" class="btn primary">' +
            icon("upload") +
            " Analisis file</button>" +
            '<span id="rawTemplateAction">' + button("Download template nilai", "raw-template") + '</span>' +
            button("Modul QLEAP", "raw-qleap") +
            '</div></form></section><div id="rawPreview" style="margin-top:22px"></div><div class="section-heading"><h2>Riwayat upload Anda</h2>' +
            button("Muat riwayat", "raw-history", "", "small") +
            '</div><div id="rawHistory">' +
            '<p class="muted">Klik Muat riwayat jika ingin melihat upload sebelumnya.</p>' +
            "</div>",
        );
        ["rawProgram", "rawKind", "rawPhase", "rawBatch", "rawAggregation"].forEach((name) =>
          $("f_" + name).addEventListener("change", rawScopeChanged),
        );
        rawScopeChanged();
        if (
          selected.batch &&
          options.programs[selected.program].batches.includes(selected.batch)
        )
          $("f_rawBatch").value = selected.batch;
        form("rawImportForm", async () => {
          if (rawImportState.running)
            throw new Error(
              "Tunggu penyimpanan upload yang sedang berjalan selesai.",
            );
          const scope = rawScope(),
            file = $("f_rawFile").files[0];
          if (!file) throw new Error("Pilih file mentah.");
          if (file.size > options.maxFileMB * 1024 * 1024)
            throw new Error(
              "File terlalu besar. Maksimal " + options.maxFileMB + " MB.",
            );
          rawImportState.selected = scope;
          rawImportState.preview = null;
          rawImportState.job = null;
          $("rawPreview").innerHTML =
            '<section class="card" role="status">' +
            loading() +
            "Membaca file dan mencocokkan NIK…</section>";
          try {
            const p = await rpc("prepareRawImport", S.token, {
              ...scope,
              fileName: file.name,
              mimeType: file.type,
              base64: await fileBase64(file),
              requestId: operationId(),
            });
            if (!alive(nav)) return;
            rawImportState.preview = p;
            drawRawPreview();
            await rawHistory(nav);
          } catch (error) {
            if (alive(nav))
              $("rawPreview").innerHTML =
                '<div class="notice amber">' + esc(error.message) + "</div>";
            throw error;
          }
        });
        drawRawPreview();
        bindRawBundle_(nav,options);
      }
      function rawIssues(title, rows, total) {
        return total
          ? '<details class="raw-issues"><summary>' +
              esc(title) +
              " · " +
              total +
              "</summary>" +
              table(
                ["Baris", "NIK", "Keterangan"],
                rows
                  .map(
                    (r) =>
                      "<tr><td>" +
                      r.rowNo +
                      "</td><td>" +
                      esc(r.nik) +
                      '</td><td class="wrap">' +
                      esc(r.message) +
                      "</td></tr>",
                  )
                  .join(""),
              ) +
              (total > rows.length
                ? '<p class="muted">Menampilkan ' +
                  rows.length +
                  " catatan pertama.</p>"
                : "") +
              "</details>"
          : "";
      }
      function drawRawPreview() {
        if (!$("rawPreview")) return;
        const p = rawImportState.preview,
          j = rawImportState.job;
        if (j) {
          drawRawJob(j);
          return;
        }
        if (!p) return;
        const s = p.summary,
          syllabus = s.kind === "SYLLABUS",
          modules = syllabus
            ? rawImportState.options.programs[s.program].phases[s.phase].map(
                (x) => x.module,
              )
            : [];
        let html =
          '<section class="card"><div class="program-header"><div><span class="program-tag">Preview</span><h2 style="margin-top:10px">' +
          esc(s.program) +
          " · " +
          esc(s.batch) +
          (syllabus ? " · " + esc(s.phase) : s.kind === "PANEL" ? " · Panel" : " · Behavior") +
          '</h2><p class="muted">' +
          esc(p.sheetName) +
          " · " +
          s.sourceRows +
          " baris sumber · " +
          s.matchedParticipants +
          " peserta cocok</p></div>" +
          badge(s.errorCount ? "Perlu diperiksa" : "Siap ditinjau") +
          '</div><div class="notice">Pencocokan memakai NIK + program + batch. Panel tanpa NIK memakai nama unik + region dalam batch tujuan. Nilai akhir: 10%–15%–15%–30%–30%; minimum lulus 80 setelah semua komponen lengkap.</div>';
        if (syllabus) {
          html +=
            "<details " +
            (s.unmappedColumns ? "open" : "") +
            "><summary>Pemetaan " +
            p.columns.length +
            " kolom nilai" +
            (s.unmappedColumns
              ? " · " + s.unmappedColumns + " belum dipilih"
              : "") +
            '</summary><form id="rawMappingForm"><div class="raw-mappings">' +
            p.columns
              .map(
                (c, i) =>
                  '<div class="raw-map-row"><div><strong>' +
                  esc(c.sourceLabel) +
                  '</strong><small class="muted" style="display:block">Kolom sumber ' +
                  (c.col + 1) +
                  "</small></div>" +
                  select(
                    "Kompetensi tujuan " + (i + 1),
                    c.id,
                    [
                      { value: "", label: "Pilih kompetensi…" },
                      ...modules,
                      { value: "IGNORE", label: "Lewati kolom ini" },
                    ],
                    c.module,
                  ) +
                  "</div>",
              )
              .join("") +
            '</div><button type="submit" class="btn">Perbarui preview</button><p class="muted" style="margin-top:10px">Pemetaan baru diterapkan setelah preview diperbarui. Pilih Lewati jika kolom tidak termasuk kurikulum phase ini.</p></form></details>';
        }
        html +=
          rawIssues("Baris / nilai bermasalah", p.errors, s.errorCount) +
          rawIssues("Catatan pemeriksaan", p.warnings, s.warningCount) +
          '<div class="section-heading"><h3>Peserta tujuan</h3><span class="muted">' +
          Math.min(50, p.totalItems) +
          " dari " +
          p.totalItems +
          "</span></div>" +
          table(
            [
              "NIK / Nama",
              "Sebelumnya",
              syllabus ? "Nilai modul yang akan masuk" : s.kind === "PANEL" ? "Rekap panel" : "Rekap behavior",
            ],
            p.rows
              .map(
                (r) =>
                  "<tr><td>" +
                  esc(r.nik) +
                  '<small class="muted" style="display:block">' +
                  esc(r.name) +
                  "</small></td><td>" +
                  fmt(r.currentScore) +
                  '</td><td class="wrap">' +
                  (syllabus
                    ? Object.entries(r.scores)
                        .map(
                          ([module, score]) =>
                            esc(module) + ": <strong>" + score + "</strong>",
                        )
                        .join("<br>") ||
                      '<span class="muted">Riwayat saja; nilai tertinggi atau koreksi Admin dipertahankan.</span>'
                    : "<strong>" +
                      fmt(r.preview.score) +
                      " / 5</strong> · " +
                      r.preview.observations +
                      " observasi, " +
                      r.preview.usedObservations +
                      " dipakai") +
                  (syllabus && r.preview?.weighted ? '<p class="muted" style="margin:8px 0 0">Skor akhir berbobot: <strong>' + (r.preview.finalScore === "" ? 'Menunggu 6 nilai lengkap' : fmt(r.preview.finalScore)) + '</strong></p>' : '') +
                  "</td></tr>",
              )
              .join(""),
          ) +
          '<div class="actions" style="margin-top:18px">' +
          button(
            "Simpan rekap " + p.totalItems + " peserta",
            "raw-confirm",
            !p.totalItems || s.unmappedColumns ? "disabled" : "",
            "primary",
          ) +
          '<span class="muted">' +
          (syllabus ? s.scoreCells + " nilai modul dipilih" : "Skala 1–5") +
          " · " +
          s.blankRows +
          " baris tanpa nilai dipetakan</span></div>" +
          (s.unmappedColumns
            ? '<p class="muted" role="status">Selesaikan pemetaan atau pilih Lewati pada kolom yang belum dikenali.</p>'
            : "") +
          "</section>";
        $("rawPreview").innerHTML = html;
        if (syllabus) {
          const previewNav = S.nav;
          document.querySelectorAll("#rawMappingForm select").forEach((el) =>
            el.addEventListener("change", () => {
              const b = document.querySelector('[data-action="raw-confirm"]');
              if (b) b.disabled = true;
            }),
          );
          form("rawMappingForm", async (data) => {
            const current = rawImportState.preview,
              res = await rpc(
                "previewRawImport",
                S.token,
                current.uploadId,
                Object.fromEntries(data),
                current.previewVersion,
              );
            if (!alive(previewNav) || rawImportState.preview !== current)
              return;
            rawImportState.preview = res;
            drawRawPreview();
          });
        }
      }
      async function rawHistory(nav = S.nav, force = true) {
        const rows = await resource("getRawImportHistory", [], 30000, force);
        if (!alive(nav) || !$("rawHistory")) return;
        const program = rawImportState.selected?.program,
          filtered = program ? rows.filter((j) => j.program === program) : rows;
        $("rawHistory").innerHTML = filtered.length
          ? table(
              ["Waktu / File", "Tujuan", "Status", "Proses", ""],
              filtered
                .map(
                  (j) =>
                    '<tr><td class="wrap">' +
                    date(j.createdAt) +
                    '<small class="muted" style="display:block">' +
                    esc(j.fileName) +
                    "</small></td><td>" +
                    esc(j.program) +
                    " · " +
                    esc(j.batch) +
                    '<small class="muted" style="display:block">' +
                    esc(j.phase || "Behavior") +
                    "</small></td><td>" +
                    badge(j.status) +
                    "</td><td>" +
                    j.nextIndex +
                    " / " +
                    j.totalItems +
                    "</td><td>" +
                    button(
                      "Lihat status",
                      "raw-status",
                      'data-id="' + esc(j.uploadId) + '"',
                      "small",
                    ) +
                    "</td></tr>",
                )
                .join(""),
            )
          : empty(
              "Belum ada upload",
              "Mulai dari file mentah syllabus atau behavior.",
            );
      }
      function drawRawJob(j) {
        if (!$("rawPreview")) return;
        const done = ["COMPLETE", "COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS"].includes(j.status),
          review = j.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW",
          processing = j.status === "PROCESSING";
        $("rawPreview").innerHTML =
          '<section class="card"><h2>' +
          (done
            ? "Rekap selesai"
            : review
              ? "Upload perlu diperiksa"
              : processing
                ? "Sedang memproses…"
                : "Upload siap dilanjutkan") +
          "</h2><p>" +
          esc(j.program) +
          " · " +
          esc(j.batch) +
          " · " +
          esc(j.phase || "Behavior") +
          '</p><progress class="raw-progress" value="' +
          j.nextIndex +
          '" max="' +
          (j.totalItems || 1) +
          '"></progress><p role="status">' +
          j.nextIndex +
          " / " +
          j.totalItems +
          " peserta · " +
          j.written +
          " diproses · " +
          j.skipped +
          " dilewati · " +
          j.failed +
          " gagal</p>" +
          (j.summary.errorCount
            ? '<p class="muted">Preview mencatat ' +
              j.summary.errorCount +
              " baris / nilai bermasalah yang dilewati.</p>"
            : "") +
          (review
            ? '<div class="notice amber">' +
              esc(j.error) +
              " Sebagian data mungkin sudah tersimpan. Periksa sheet assessment, enrollment, dan riwayat sebelum mengunggah file kembali.</div>"
            : "") +
          '<div class="actions">' +
          (!done && !review && !processing
            ? button("Lanjutkan penyimpanan", "raw-resume", "", "primary")
            : "") +
          button(
            "Muat status",
            "raw-status",
            'data-id="' + esc(j.uploadId) + '"',
          ) +
          "</div>" +
          rawIssues(
            "Peserta yang gagal",
            (j.outcomes || [])
              .filter((x) => x.status === "FAILED")
              .map((x) => ({ ...x, rowNo: "—" })),
            j.failed,
          ) +
          "</section>";
      }
      async function runRawImport() {
        if (rawImportState.running) return;
        rawImportState.running = true;
        const epoch = S.epoch,
          nav = S.nav;
        try {
          let j = rawImportState.job || {
            uploadId: rawImportState.preview.uploadId,
            previewVersion: rawImportState.preview.previewVersion,
            nextIndex: 0,
            status: "PREVIEW",
          };
          do {
            j = await rpc(
              "commitRawImport",
              S.token,
              j.uploadId,
              j.previewVersion,
              j.nextIndex,
            );
            if (S.epoch !== epoch) return;
            rawImportState.job = j;
            if (alive(nav)) drawRawJob(j);
            invalidate([
              "getDashboard",
              "getParticipantPage",
              "getParticipantFullDetail",
              "getParticipantAssessmentDetail",
              "getParticipantWorkspace",
              "getBehaviorDetail",
              "getPanelDetail",
              "getRawImportHistory",
              "getCertificatesOverview",
            ]);
          } while (j.status === "READY" && alive(nav));
          if (["COMPLETE", "COMPLETE_WITH_ERRORS"].includes(j.status)) {
            toast("Rekap selesai. " + j.written + " peserta diproses.");
            if (alive(nav)) await rawHistory(nav);
          } else if (j.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW")
            toast("Upload perlu diperiksa sebelum diulang.", true);
        } catch (error) {
          if (epoch === S.epoch) {
            const id =
              rawImportState.job?.uploadId || rawImportState.preview?.uploadId;
            if (id && alive(nav))
              $("rawPreview").innerHTML =
                '<div class="notice amber">' +
                esc(error.message) +
                " Muat status untuk memeriksa hasil.</div>" +
                button(
                  "Muat status",
                  "raw-status",
                  'data-id="' + esc(id) + '"',
                );
          }
          throw error;
        } finally {
          if (epoch === S.epoch) rawImportState.running = false;
        }
      }
      function confirmRawImport() {
        const p = rawImportState.preview;
        if (!p) return;
        modal(
          "Simpan hasil upload",
          p.totalItems + " peserta cocok dengan program dan batch tujuan.",
          "<p>Nilai yang dipetakan dan observasi valid akan masuk ke rekap peserta. " +
            p.summary.errorCount +
            ' catatan bermasalah dilewati. Periksa tujuan dan preview sebelum menyimpan.</p><div class="modal-actions">' +
            button("Batal", "close-modal") +
            button("Simpan rekap", "raw-start", "", "primary") +
            "</div>",
        );
      }
      async function rawStatus(id) {
        if (rawImportState.running)
          throw new Error("Penyimpanan masih berjalan. Tunggu proses selesai.");
        const nav = S.nav,
          j = await rpc("getRawImportStatus", S.token, id);
        if (!alive(nav)) return;
        if (j.status === "PREVIEW") {
          const p = await rpc("getRawImportPreview", S.token, id);
          if (!alive(nav)) return;
          rawImportState.preview = p;
          rawImportState.job = null;
          drawRawPreview();
          return;
        }
        rawImportState.job = j;
        drawRawJob(j);
      }
      function panelistFeedback_(o) {
        const feedback = String(o.recommendations == null ? "" : o.recommendations).trim();
        return '<section class="panelist-feedback" aria-label="Feedback panelis"><h4>Feedback panelis</h4><p' +
          (feedback ? '' : ' class="muted"') + '>' + esc(feedback || "Panelis ini belum memberikan feedback pada data yang diimpor.") + '</p></section>';
      }
      async function behaviorModal(t, panel = false) {
        const serial = modal(
          panel ? "Nilai & Feedback Panelisasi" : "Behavior Monitoring",
          t.program + " · " + t.batch,
          loading(),
        );
        try {
          const d = await resource(panel ? "getPanelDetail" : "getBehaviorDetail", [t], 30000, panel);
          if (serial !== S.modal) return;
          const policy = {
              LATEST: "Observasi terbaru",
              RATER_LATEST: "Terbaru tiap observer",
              ALL_MEAN: "Seluruh observasi",
            },
            s = d.summary;
          const html =
            (d.historicalScore !== null && d.historicalScore !== undefined ? '<div class="notice">Nilai historis yang dipertahankan: <strong>'+fmt(d.historicalScore)+(panel || Number(d.historicalScore)>5?' / 100':' / 5')+'</strong>. Rincian penilaian sumber ditampilkan di bawah.</div>' : '') +
            '<div class="notice">' +
            (d.participantFallbackScore !== null && d.participantFallbackScore !== undefined ? "Nilai dari Participant: "+fmt(d.participantFallbackScore)+" / 100. Rincian penilai belum tersedia untuk batch ini." : s.score !== undefined
              ? "Rekap " +
                fmt(s.score) +
                " / 5 · " +
                esc(policy[s.policy] || s.policy) +
                " · " +
                s.usedObservations +
                " observasi dipakai."
              : panel ? "Rekap panel belum tersedia." : "Rekap behavior belum tersedia.") +
            "</div>" +
            (d.observations.length
              ? d.observations
                  .map(
                    (o) =>
                      '<section class="behavior-entry"><h3>' +
                      date(o.observedAt) +
                      " · " +
                      esc(o.observerName || (panel ? "Panelis belum tercatat" : "Observer")) +
                      "</h3>" + (panel ? "<p>Rata-rata <strong>" + fmt(o.score) + " / 5</strong> · Nilai <strong>" + fmt(Number(o.score)*20) + " / 100</strong></p>" : "<p>Core <strong>" +
                      fmt(o.core) +
                      "</strong> · Technical <strong>" +
                      fmt(o.technical) +
                      "</strong> · Rata-rata <strong>" +
                      fmt(o.score) +
                      " / 5</strong></p>") +
                      (panel ? panelistFeedback_(o) : [
                        ["Kekuatan utama", o.strengths],
                        ["Area perbaikan", o.improvementAreas],
                        ["Rekomendasi", o.recommendations],
                      ]
                        .filter((x) => x[1])
                        .map(
                          ([label, text]) =>
                            "<p><strong>" +
                            label +
                            "</strong><br>" +
                            esc(text) +
                            "</p>",
                        )
                        .join("")) +
                      "<details><summary>Detail indikator</summary>" +
                      table(
                        ["Indikator", "Penilaian"],
                        Object.entries({
                          ...o.details.ratings,
                          ...o.details.checks,
                        })
                          .map(
                            ([label, value]) =>
                              '<tr><td class="wrap">' +
                              esc(label) +
                              "</td><td>" +
                              esc(value) +
                              "</td></tr>",
                          )
                          .join(""),
                      ) +
                      "</details></section>",
                  )
                  .join("")
              : empty(panel ? "Feedback panelis belum tersedia. Unggah data panel yang memuat feedback untuk menampilkannya di sini." : "Belum ada observasi")) +
            (d.total > 20
              ? '<p class="muted">Menampilkan 20 observasi terbaru dari ' +
                d.total +
                ".</p>"
              : "");
          $("modalContent").querySelector(".loading-state")?.remove();
          $("modalContent").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", html);
        } catch (error) {
          if (serial === S.modal) {
            closeModal();
            handleError(error);
          }
        }
      }

      function openRawProgram(program) {
        if (S.view === "rawimport" && rawImportState.selected?.program === program) return;
        if (rawImportState.running)
          return toast("Tunggu penyimpanan upload selesai.", true);
        rawImportState.selected = {
          kind: rawImportState.selected?.kind || "SYLLABUS",
          program,
          phase: rawImportState.selected?.phase || "PHASE 2",
          aggregation: rawImportState.selected?.aggregation || "LATEST",
        };
        rawImportState.preview = null;
        rawImportState.job = null;
        return navigate("rawimport", { program });
      }

        "switch-role": () => {

              select(

                  value: r,

                })),
                u.role,
              ) +
              '<div id="switchAdminPassword">' + field(

                'autocomplete="current-password"',
              ) +
              '</div>' + formActions("Gunakan peran") +
              "</form>",
          );
          const switchForm = $("switchForm");
          const switchRoleSelect = switchForm.querySelector('[name="role"]');
          const switchPassword = switchForm.querySelector('[name="password"]');
          const updateSwitchPassword = () => {
            const admin = switchRoleSelect.value === "ADMIN";
            $("switchAdminPassword").hidden = !admin;
            switchPassword.required = admin;
            switchPassword.disabled = !admin;
            if (!admin) switchPassword.value = "";
          };
          switchRoleSelect.addEventListener("change", updateSwitchPassword);
          updateSwitchPassword();
          form("switchForm", async (data) => {
            await rpc(
              "switchRole",
              S.token,
              data.get("role"),
              data.get("password"),
            );
            S.epoch++;
            S.nav++;
            S.cache.clear();
            clearRetainedViews_();
            S.inflight.clear();
            S.selected.clear();
            S.queue.splice(0).forEach((job) => job.reject(staleError()));
            closeModal();
            S.segment="ALL";
            await loadDashboard(true);
            navigate("segments");
          });
        },
      };
      function turnPage(step) {
        if (S.view === "database") {
          listState.page = Math.max(1, listState.page + step);
          return navigate(S.view, S.params);
        }
        if (S.view === "users") {
          userPage.page = Math.max(1, userPage.page + step);
          return navigate("users");
        }
        if (S.view === "certificates") {
          certPage.page = Math.max(1, certPage.page + step);
          return navigate("certificates");
        }
        if (S.view === "qleap") {
          qleapPage.page = Math.max(1, qleapPage.page + step);
          return navigate("qleap");
        }
      }
      document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const el = event.target.closest("[data-action]");
        if (!el || el.disabled) return;
        const action = actions[el.dataset.action];
        if (!action) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        Promise.resolve()
          .then(() => action(el))
          .catch(handleError);
      });
      $("dialog").addEventListener("cancel", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeModal();
      });
      $("dialog").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target !== $("dialog")) return;
        const r = $("dialog").getBoundingClientRect();
        if (
          e.clientX < r.left ||
          e.clientX > r.right ||
          e.clientY < r.top ||
          e.clientY > r.bottom
        )
          closeModal();
      });
      $("sidebarBackdrop").addEventListener("click", () => {
        $("sidebar").classList.remove("open");
        $("sidebarBackdrop").classList.remove("open");
      });
      window.addEventListener(
        "online",
        () => ($("networkBanner").hidden = true),
      );
      window.addEventListener(
        "offline",
        () => ($("networkBanner").hidden = false),
      );
      $("loginRole").addEventListener("change", () => {
        $("passwordField").hidden = $("loginRole").value !== "ADMIN";
        $("password").required = $("loginRole").value === "ADMIN";
        if ($("passwordField").hidden) $("password").value = "";
      });
      $("loginForm").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!$("loginForm").reportValidity()) return;
        const btn = $("loginSubmit");
        busy(btn, async () => {
          $("loginError").hidden = true;
          try {
            const result = await rpc("login", {
              nik: $("nik").value.trim(),
              role: $("loginRole").value,
              password: $("password").value,
              bootstrap: true,
              fast: true,
            });
            S.token = result.token;
            S.session = result;
            S.epoch++;
            S.cache.clear();
            clearRetainedViews_();
            S.inflight.clear();
            S.view = "overview";
            $("password").value = "";
            $("loginPage").hidden = true;
            $("app").hidden = false;
            content(loading());
            if(result.dashboard) applyDashboard_(result.dashboard);
            else await loadDashboard(true);
            await navigate(result.dashboard?.segment==="ALL" ? "segments" : "overview");
            if (result.passwordCreated) toast("Password Admin tersimpan. Gunakan password ini untuk login berikutnya.");
          } catch (e) {
            if (S.token) {
              errorScreen(e);
            } else {
              $("loginError").hidden = false;
              $("loginError").textContent = message(e);
            }
          }
        });
      });
      async function initialize() {
        document
          .querySelectorAll("[data-logo]")
          .forEach((el) => (el.src = EMBEDDED_LOGO));
        $("refreshButton").innerHTML =
          icon("refresh") + "<span>Muat ulang</span>";
        $("menuButton").innerHTML = icon("menu");
        try {
          const cfg = await rpc("getLoginConfig",{light:true});
          if (!cfg.ready)
            throw new Error(
              "Aplikasi belum siap. Admin perlu menyelesaikan pembaruan sistem.",
            );
          $("loginRole").innerHTML = cfg.roles
            .map(
              (r) =>
                '<option value="' +
                esc(r.value) +
                '">' +
                esc(r.label) +
                "</option>",
            )
            .join("");
          $("loginSubmit").disabled = false;
          $("loginState").textContent =
            "Peserta, Superior, dan CLP cukup NIK. Admin menggunakan NIK dan password.";
        } catch (e) {
          $("loginError").hidden = false;
          $("loginError").textContent = message(e);
          $("loginState").textContent =
            "Hubungi Admin jika aplikasi belum dapat diakses.";
        }
      }
      initialize();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
